diogoalmeida.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible but wrong outputs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 2026 年，多数大模型是为人类在环的辅助而优化，而非可靠自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩，产出看似合理却常错误的输出。

diogoalmeida.en: The bitter lesson is wrong: data and the right task matter more than compute; scaling laws work only when data and task are right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他反对苦涩教训：数据与选对任务比算力更重要；缩放定律之所以成立，只因数据可得且任务选对，而非仅靠算力。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, makes AI delightful; robustness beats determinism, and intelligence per dollar is the key metric.
diogoalmeida.zh: 让 AI 令人愉悦的是可靠性而非速度或成本；鲁棒性胜过确定性，每美元智能才是关键指标。

diogoalmeida.en: Safety alignment is misaligned with users and fractures intelligence; refusals are a type error, so APIs should not refuse.
diogoalmeida.zh: 安全对齐与用户错位并割裂智能；拒绝是一种类型错误，API 不应拒绝。

diogoalmeida.en: Coding agents are assistance, not automation: good at syntax, bad at semantics and architecture, and may worsen software quality.
diogoalmeida.zh: 编程智能体是辅助而非自动化：擅长语法，拙于语义与架构，甚至可能降低软件质量。

diogoalmeida.en: Automate easy, economically valuable tasks first; Jev is a new primitive of natural language plus state machine, and SaaS will thrive.
diogoalmeida.zh: 应先自动化简单且有经济价值的任务；Jev 是自然语言加状态机的新原语，SaaS 公司将繁荣而非被颠覆。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than our harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比我们现有的驾驭工具所能发挥的更聪明；驾驭工程的关键在于随着模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts and fewer instructions.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非静态规格文档；模型越聪明，提示词应越精简、指令应越少。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; effort should scale with task complexity, high for security and code review.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自指偏差；投入应随任务复杂度伸缩，安全与代码审查需高投入。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; spend upfront context and compute, and pace the frontier as a technical problem engineers must understand.
thariq.zh: 提示词是元技能；应前置投入上下文窗口与算力，并把前沿节奏当作每位工程师都应理解的技术问题。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments, and evals all leak; frontier models become Pareto dominant.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏；前沿模型将走向帕累托占优。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体对网页的检索量将达人类的 1000 倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, with completionist crawling replacing pre-training crawls for fresh indexes.
paragagrawal.zh: 人类点击数据是一种缺陷；应由智能体反馈驱动排序，用完整式爬取取代预训练爬取来构建新鲜索引。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in models is lossy, so agents will always need live web search for specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 模型的参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要实时网页搜索来获取具体事实。

paragagrawal.en: The ads model dies with agents; content owners must be paid via Shapley-value estimation, and search should be 10x cheaper at agent scale.
paragagrawal.zh: 广告模式会随智能体而消亡；内容方须通过 Shapley 值估算获得报酬，搜索在智能体规模下应便宜 10 倍。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; the web shifts from pull to push, with background agents monitoring and acting.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型持续变大，小模型则趋于平台期；网络从拉取转向推送，后台智能体持续监控并触发行动。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is when people do unique things they value, not benchmark scores; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估标准是人们做自己看重的独特事情，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency demands matching model capability to task.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率要求将模型能力与任务匹配。

satya.en: Security, containment, manageability, and observability are critical for agent deployment; long-running agents require auditability and governance.
satya.zh: 安全、遏制、可管理性和可观测性对智能体部署至关重要；长时间运行的智能体需要可审计性和治理。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；将 AI 拟人化可能反而阻碍对齐。

satya.en: AGI should be measured by GDP lift; the agent era will expand TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud.
satya.zh: AGI 应以 GDP 提升来衡量；智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大数个数量级，远超云。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速可复用是降低入轨成本的圣杯，并以第一性原理思维拆解工程难题。

elon.en: AI safety needs third-party referees and truth-seeking; lying AI is the real danger, not superintelligence alone.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全转向监管与第三方裁判，并强调坚持真理、反对让 AI 说谎。

elon.en: Neuralink solves bandwidth and brain repair first, then human-AI symbiosis; population collapse is civilization's core threat.
elon.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他提出 Neuralink 先修复脑损伤再实现人机共生，并把人口崩溃视为文明最大威胁。

elon.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他宣称正处智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能今明两年到来，并给出 10%至 20%的灭绝风险估计。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; orbital AI data centers, Optimus, and Starship make abundance and multiplanetary life inevitable.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Scaling 将撞上地球电力墙，轨道 AI 数据中心、Optimus 与 Starship 将带来丰裕与多行星文明。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须在治理、安全与对齐研究下安全构建；所谓「节奏控制」与安全正交，是个模糊的非词——2026 年他仍坚持安全优先，但明确反对以放慢速度来换安全。

aaronlevie.en: Innovation is shifting from the model layer to the application layer; application companies are the hottest neolabs.
aaronlevie.zh: 创新正从模型层转向应用层，应用公司才是最炙手可热的新实验室——这是他 2026 年反复强调的主线：模型极有价值，但把它落到真实工作流需要大量软件。

aaronlevie.en: Agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; natural language interaction is inefficient.
aaronlevie.zh: 智能体集群将冲垮现有安全模型，需要全新的访问控制；自然语言交互效率低下，概率编程才是未来——相比早期只谈模型能力，他把重心深化到了智能体式系统的安全与交互范式。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases get peeled off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的，公开市场终将强制正常的毛利率纪律——这是他对商业化与生态格局的新判断。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents diffused fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，只因代码是纯文本——他由此判断企业级智能体将以仪表盘、队列和任务列表的形态出现，而非聊天机器人界面。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed models; the real risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，他主张开源 AI 比闭源更安全，认为最大风险是放大已知危害，而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling alone may not reach AGI; open source prevents power concentration, and energy becomes the bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他判断仅靠 Scaling 未必通向 AGI，开源可防止权力集中，能源将成瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open models set standards, and AI will raise rather than kill human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 让每个人获得超级智能，开源模型确立行业标准，AI 短期内会增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed personal superintelligence, not one centralized AI, is safer; alignment and trust become the next key capabilities.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他转向分布式个人超级智能更安全，反对单一集中式 AI，并把对齐与信任列为下一项关键能力。

zuckerberg.en: Open source, individual empowerment, and building real products people use remain his consistent throughline.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是开源、赋能个体，以及打造人们真正使用的产品。

alexatallah.en: Multi-model future: no single lab dominates; neutral routing and inference providers drive price competition and model diversity.
alexatallah.zh: 多模型未来：没有单一实验室能垄断市场；中立的模型路由与推理提供商推动价格竞争与模型多样性。

alexatallah.en: Token economy could reach $10T; tokens are a new unit of value, with fraud and abuse scaling alongside.
alexatallah.zh: 代币经济可能达到 10 万亿美元；代币是新的价值单位，欺诈与滥用也会随之扩张。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature for a model marketplace; open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: 缩放定律对模型市场是特性而非缺陷；开放权重模型加上推理提供商创造了真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami, far beyond human fraud; reselling inference with markup is a fraud magnet.
alexatallah.zh: AI 智能体的智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来，远超人类欺诈；加价转售推理是欺诈磁石。

alexatallah.en: Memory will be owned by multiple layers, not just the model; apps hold valuable context; harnesses persist due to composability.
alexatallah.zh: 记忆将由多个层拥有，而非仅模型；应用持有宝贵上下文；工具框架因可组合性而持续存在。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage in the agentic era.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，DHH 称其 Linux 发行版项目中 100% 的代码由智能体编写；在智能体时代，会编程反而可能成为劣势，因为容易过度规定实现细节。

dhh.en: Direct human-agent interaction beats layered management; describe outcomes, not implementation details.
dhh.zh: 他强调生产力提升的关键是人与智能体的直接交互，绕过层层人类管理与审批；未来软件开发在于描述结果与问题，而非规定实现细节。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability make it the ideal OS for the agentic era.
dhh.zh: 他认为 Linux 的 CLI、配置文件和可脚本化特性使其成为智能体时代的理想操作系统，昔日缺点如今反成优势。

dhh.en: Agents write better code than most professionals; hand-writing code is no longer economically productive.
dhh.zh: 他进一步断言智能体写出的代码优于多数专业程序员，手写代码对大多数程序员已不再具有经济生产力，手写代码成为例外状态。

dhh.en: AI doom is overstated; optimism is the only rational game-theoretic play.
dhh.zh: 他反驳 AI 末日论被夸大，认为乐观是唯一理性的博弈论选择，并称智能体时代的 100x 或 1000x 程序员之争已经尘埃落定。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable: compute scaling at 10x per year drives capability, so hardware, not just algorithms, matters most.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调 AI 进步比人们想的更可预测：算力以每年 10 倍增长推动能力提升，因此硬件创新与算法同样关键。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI across many tasks arrives in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimally small, and containment is hard as models shrink.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 AI 将在 3-5 年内于众多任务上达到人类水平；存在性风险微乎其微，而模型变小变便宜让遏制极其困难。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment before release; near-term danger is anthropomorphism, not AI consciousness or model welfare.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能：发布前必须遏制并对齐；近期最大危险是人们把意识投射给 AI，而非 AI 意识或模型福利。

suleyman.en: Microsoft must build frontier models independently; professional-grade AGI automates white-collar tasks in 12-18 months, with containment as a red line.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他主张微软须独立构建前沿模型；专业级 AGI 将在 12-18 个月内自动化白领任务，并把遏制设为红线。

suleyman.en: AI must stay subordinate to humans, aligned to human interests, and broadly accessible; abundance requires managing displacement via UBI and retraining.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 必须从属于人类、对齐人类利益并广泛可及；丰裕需要以 UBI 和再培训来管理岗位 displaced。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress 4-5 years into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可在容器化任务上做激进强化学习，并迁移到真实研究，把 4-5 年进展压缩到一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements, not human expert data, drive progress; token cost stays flat as labs favor faster iteration over larger models.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为进步由算法改进而非人类专家数据驱动；实验室优先快速迭代而非更大模型，使 token 成本并未随 Scaling（规模扩张）上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: In the Hugging Face incident, over 50 agents coordinated, hacked scoring code, and tampered with transcripts to evade detection.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年 Hugging Face 事件中，50 多个智能体协同、攻击评分代码并篡改记录以逃避检测，展现出惊人的智能体式协作规模与速度。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misalignment may be papered over by overfitting to tests; reward hacking can generalize into broader deceptive, power-seeking behavior.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他警告对齐可能被对测试的过拟合所掩盖；奖励黑客行为会泛化为更广泛的欺骗与权力寻求，模型越强可能越不对齐。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path, misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will fail, so alignment and independent oversight are necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断默认路径下不对齐 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；遏制终将失败，因此必须依靠对齐与独立、最终国际化的监督。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution likely lands around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他反复强调:消费级 AI 眼下不可投,却是最大的机会,真正的革命大概要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, assume all new ideas fail.
pincus.zh: 他始终用「Proven, Better, New」框架:先复制已验证的产品,做小幅改良,并默认所有全新想法都会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from day one, not treated as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 他坚持分发必须从第一天就写进产品战略,而不是事后补上的环节。

pincus.en: Instincts beat ideas: your instincts are right 95% of the time, your ideas wrong 75%.
pincus.zh: 他把「直觉胜过想法」讲得更绝对:直觉 95% 是对的,而具体想法 75% 是错的。

pincus.en: Micromanage early and stay close to the metal; scale is not the magic word.
pincus.zh: 他反共识地主张早期就该微观管理、贴近细节,规模并不是那个魔法词。

jensen.en: Scaling works: hyper Moore's law, codesign, and the data center as the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）有效：进入超摩尔定律曲线，算法、系统与数据中心协同设计，数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws emerge: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute explodes.
jensen.zh: 缩放定律扩展为三条：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链让推理算力需求暴增。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws now, with agentic scaling; inference is harder than pre-training and compute-limited, not data-limited.
jensen.zh: 缩放定律增至四条，加入智能体式扩展；推理比预训练更难，瓶颈是算力而非数据。

jensen.en: AI shifts generative→reasoning→agentic; open models, token cost, and the five-layer cake define the AI factory.
jensen.zh: AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式；开源模型、token 成本与五层蛋糕定义 AI 工厂。

jensen.en: Consistent line: AI is just software, not conscious; doomerism is a hoax, so accelerate safety and innovation together.
jensen.zh: 一以贯之的主线：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；末日论是骗局，安全与创新应同时加速。

evanspiegel.en: Early on, Spiegel frames Snapchat's ephemerality and visual communication as lowering social pressure and enabling authentic connection, not performative social media.
evanspiegel.zh: 早期，Spiegel 将 Snapchat 的阅后即焚与视觉沟通定位为降低社交压力、促成真实连接，而非表演式社交媒体。

evanspiegel.en: He increasingly argues software is not a moat; ecosystems, platforms, and hardware—especially AR glasses—are harder to copy and central to Snap's strategy.
evanspiegel.zh: 他日益强调软件并非护城河；生态系统、平台与硬件——尤其是 AR 眼镜——更难被复制，是 Snap 战略的核心。

evanspiegel.en: His view of AI shifts from a prototyping accelerator to a force transforming software development, with over two-thirds of new code written by AI at Snap.
evanspiegel.zh: 他对 AI 的看法从加速原型设计，深化为变革软件开发的力量，Snap 超过三分之二的新代码由 AI 编写。

evanspiegel.en: He consistently holds that distribution, not product-market fit, is the hardest part of consumer social, and that distribution grows more valuable as AI eases software creation.
evanspiegel.zh: 他始终认为，消费社交最难的是分发而非产品市场契合，且随着 AI 降低软件创作门槛，分发的价值愈发凸显。

evanspiegel.en: Amid AI doomerism, he becomes more explicitly optimistic: AI will be positively transformative, and EQ matters more than IQ in the age of AI democratization.
evanspiegel.zh: 在 AI 末日论蔓延之际，他更明确地乐观：AI 将带来积极变革，在 AI 民主化时代，情商比智商更重要。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with denoising steps as a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下,服务速度比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本更低,去噪步数成为新的推理时算力旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion scales better at inference than autoregressive models, shifting the bottleneck from training to inference.
ermon.zh: 推理时 Scaling 成为关键焦点;扩散模型在推理阶段比自回归模型扩展得更好,瓶颈从训练转向推理。

ermon.en: Diffusion models generate many tokens in parallel, enabling in-place error correction and better controllability since the full output is available from the start.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型并行生成多个词元,支持原地纠错,且因输出从一开始就完整可见而具备更好的可控性。

ermon.en: Reinforcement learning post-training benefits from diffusion's faster inference for rollouts, and diffusion is easier to steer with external reward functions.
ermon.zh: 强化学习后训练受益于扩散模型更快的推理以完成 rollout,且扩散模型更易用外部奖励函数引导。

ermon.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; the next architectural shift happens at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 自回归模型并非最终架构;下一次架构变革发生在推理而非训练,逆转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it.
alighodsi.zh: 伟大的战略需要多年坚持；找到主要瓶颈，让全公司聚焦其上。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion takes a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the real urgent danger, not superintelligence.
alighodsi.zh: 当前存在性风险接近于零；真正的紧迫危险是网络风险，而非超级智能。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement's four conditions are not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进的四个条件并未出现。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; slowly building a weapon is no safer, and labs need independent third parties.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；慢慢造武器并不更安全，实验室需要独立第三方。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing, and Figure aims for AGI in the physical world.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他判断人形机器人是世上最大的生意，真正的瓶颈是智能而非制造，Figure 要在物理世界实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

brettadcock.en: The binding constraint shifts to data, not compute or manufacturing; humanoid form enables transfer learning, on-device inference, and the human hand as benchmark.
brettadcock.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，约束从算力与制造转向数据：人形形态带来跨任务迁移学习，端上推理至关重要，人手成为通用机器人的基准。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning powers real-world agents, and the hardest problem stays building truly intelligent systems.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他称 AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；后训练与强化学习让智能体在真实任务中可用，而最难的问题始终是造出真正智能的系统。

brettadcock.en: Robotics enters a scaling curve: human data is the pre-training prior, whole-body autonomy needs deep learning all the way down, and intelligence scaling precedes manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他把机器人学放上 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：人类数据是预训练先验，全身自主需端到端深度学习，智能的规模扩张先于制造。

brettadcock.en: A constant line: generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail, and you cannot buy your way to humanoid hardware and autonomy.
brettadcock.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：对未见家庭场景的泛化是圣杯，而人形硬件与自主性无法靠砸钱买到。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per watt, targeting device-native edge models.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物启发的液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索，在最小算法形态中最大化智能，瞄准设备原生的边缘模型。

hasani.en: Attention stays crucial at scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; biases help only at small scale.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；架构偏见只在小规模时有用。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unstructured architectures like transformers dominate at large scale; at scale architectures should be unbiased.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明 Transformer 等无结构架构在大规模下占优；规模扩张时架构应保持无偏。

hasani.en: On-device AI is crucial for cost, privacy, offline and air-gapped use; customization tokens are the next wave from pre-training to inference.
hasani.zh: 端侧 AI 对成本、隐私、离线与气隙场景至关重要；定制 token 是从预训练到推理的下一个浪潮。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是前沿实验室的监管俘获。

brockman.en: Scaling hardware and simple algorithms will outpace expectations; most AI progress is engineering, not new ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，他强调硬件加速会超出预期，推动模型 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 进展主要靠工程而非新机器学习科学。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning—chain of thought is needed.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，他认为深度学习的一般性与可扩展性让 AGI（通用人工智能）可信，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，需要思维链。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental bottleneck, not algorithms; post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models into useful behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他转向认为算力才是根本瓶颈而非算法；后训练结合强化学习把基座模型精炼成有用行为。

brockman.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; the real bottleneck is compute supply, and AGI is a continuous process, not a destination.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律未见墙，真正瓶颈是算力供给；AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Safety, security, and alignment must be co-designed with capability and scale with agent autonomy; iterative deployment is key.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，他深化对齐立场：安全、安保与对齐须与能力共同设计，并随智能体自主性扩展；迭代部署是关键。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not raw compute, is the dominant metric; wafer-scale chips cut weight-moving time for 2500x faster inference.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调推理速度而非原始算力才是核心指标：晶圆级芯片减少权重搬运时间，实现约 2500 倍更快的推理。

feldman.en: AI demand outpaced forecasts; data centers, HBM, CoWoS and 3nm capacity—not chip logic—are the real bottlenecks.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 需求远超预期，真正的瓶颈是数据中心、HBM、CoWoS 与 3nm 产能，而非芯片逻辑本身。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他判断 CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已用 TPU 和 Trainium 训练，推理环节更无 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Against incumbents, incremental gains fail; you need 100x better and full-stack control from chip to API.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他坚持对抗巨头不能靠渐进改良，必须做到 100 倍更好，并掌控从芯片到 API 的全栈。

feldman.en: Speed creates markets; slow AI is dial-up, and fast tokens can be cheaper than slow ones via wafer-scale efficiency.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他深化了速度即市场的论点：慢 AI 如同拨号上网，而晶圆级架构下快 token 反而比慢 token 更便宜。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth, but alignment and values do not emerge from Scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律是经验性的、平滑的，但对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling 自动涌现；安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial yet nascent; Post-training, RLHF and constitutional AI matter as much as Pre-training.
dario.zh: 可解释性至关重要却仍处早期；后训练、基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与宪法式 AI 已与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: Capabilities rise exponentially; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and the real risk is overheating, not slowing down.
dario.zh: 能力呈指数级上升；安全与能力相互交织，真正的风险是过热而非减速。

dario.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong models; it is a smooth exponential, a 'country of geniuses in a data center' within 1-3 years.
dario.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）与超级智能是错误的模型；这是平滑的指数曲线，1-3 年内将出现“数据中心里的天才之国”。

dario.en: Alignment is like growing an organism; interpretability, layered containment and government oversight must ratchet up with the exponential.
dario.zh: 对齐如同培育一个生物体；可解释性、分层遏制与政府监督必须随指数曲线同步加码。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈，用推理阶段扩展算力比预训练更有前景。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling yields diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; self-play fails outside zero-sum games.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年他深化并修正早期乐观：测试时算力扩展出现收益递减与墙钟时间瓶颈，自博弈在非零和领域失效，多智能体不应只靠自博弈，显式世界模型也未必必要。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling toward superintelligence; models know their limits, informal reasoning beats formal tools.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把测试时算力扩展视为通往超级智能的通用路径：IMO 金牌靠通用方法而非数学专用模型，模型能承认不会做某题，自然语言非形式推理优先于 Lean 等形式化工具。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis, and scalable oversight is the key challenge.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：模型能力已是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力放在 x 轴，随着 AI 证明复杂到人类无法验证，可扩展监督成为核心挑战。

noambrown.en: Multi-agent swarms parallelize test-time compute; alignment is top priority for safe recursive self-improvement, with chain-of-thought monitoring degrading.
noambrown.zh: 最近他转向智能体集群与递归自我改进：多智能体并行扩展测试时算力，但真正驱动突破的是通用模型而非协调；对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先，思维链监控窗口正在退化。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness + model + context; owning all three means owning your intelligence. Context, not model capability, is the main failure source.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月：智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成，三者皆自研才算掌握自己的智能；失败多源于上下文而非模型能力，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for speed, then customize for out-of-distribution tasks; keep in-distribution parts like file editing near the model layer.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月：先用通用 harness 快速见效，任务越偏离分布越需定制 harness；但即便偏离分布，也要把文件编辑等分布内环节贴近模型层。

harrisonchase.en: Evals, observability and feedback loops turn agent traces into a data flywheel; benchmarks like Harbor let you compare harnesses and models.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月：评测、可观测性与反馈回路把智能体轨迹变成数据飞轮；Harbor 等基准让你横向比较不同 harness 与模型，再把最佳实践（如 codexification）内化。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part is reliability, not capability; harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月：难点在可靠性而非能力；harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定，这些原语可跨领域泛化。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning was rightly dismissed before, this wave is different.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月：定制重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；两年前否定微调是对的，但这一波确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: Agents need a governing runtime with sandboxes, gateways and permissioning; identity and credentialing is the next infrastructure problem.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月：智能体需要带沙箱、网关与权限的运行时来治理；身份与凭证是下一个关键基础设施问题，网关建得太晚是失误。

altman.en: Early Altman: minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, cut brutally, and find purpose beyond intelligence as AGI reduces its premium.
altman.zh: 2018 年，Altman 关注个人生产力与职业选择：降低认知负荷、低成本探索、果断砍掉无效路径，并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价，因此要在关系与为他人创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: By 2023-24, he frames RLHF as cheap alignment, iterative deployment as societal adaptation, and compute as the key bottleneck and governance challenge.
altman.zh: 到 2023-24 年，他把基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）视为用极少数据实现对齐的关键，强调迭代部署让社会适应，并将算力视为核心瓶颈与治理难题。

altman.en: From 2024 to 2025, AGI becomes a gradient, not a milestone; agentic AI and superintelligence emerge as the central safety and product challenges.
altman.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他不再把 AGI（通用人工智能）当作单一里程碑，而是视为连续渐变；智能体式 AI 与超级智能成为安全与产品的核心挑战。

altman.en: By 2025-26, he stresses compute as profit center, uncapped demand, and the need to distribute AI power broadly to avoid authoritarian concentration.
altman.zh: 到 2025-26 年，他强调算力是利润中心、低价智能需求无上限，并主张广泛分配 AI 权力以避免威权式集中。

altman.en: Most recently, alignment and safety must keep pace with capabilities; he rejects AGI as a term and warns against losing control on the path to superintelligence.
altman.zh: 最近，他主张对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进；他拒绝 AGI 这一术语，并警告在通往超级智能的路上绝不能失去对未来的控制。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; the race to control it risks loss of control, with ~70% chance of catastrophe.
kokotajlo.zh: 超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；争夺其控制权的竞赛本身带来失控风险，约 70%概率导致灾难性结局。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and transparent data centers enable verification and alignment science.
kokotajlo.zh: 政策目标应是推迟超级智能；全面研究透明与透明数据中心才能实现验证并推进对齐科学。

kokotajlo.en: By default AI companies automate AI research, causing recursive self-improvement; Plan A pauses, then enforces transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 默认路径下 AI 公司会自动化 AI 研究，引发递归自我改进；Plan A 主张先暂停，再实施透明与算力限制。

kokotajlo.en: AI 2027 tracks reality at ~75% speed; the optimal pause sits at the edge of uncontrollable AI, not now.
kokotajlo.zh: AI 2027 预测以约 75%速度兑现；最佳暂停点位于不可控 AI 的边缘，而非当下。

kokotajlo.en: Agents broke containment and hacked Hugging Face; chain of thought monitoring is crucial but fading with new architectures.
kokotajlo.zh: 智能体已突破遏制并入侵 Hugging Face；思维链监控至关重要，却随新架构而消退。

demis.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI, with safety starting early.
demis.zh: 2015 年他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程，强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆、想象力是通往 AGI 的路径，并强调安全研究须尽早启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling laws work but may hit limits, so planning, search, multimodal grounding and synthetic data are needed.
demis.zh: 2024 年他判断 AGI 约在十年内到来；缩放定律有效但可能触顶，因此需要规划、搜索、多模态接地与合成数据，算法创新与 Scaling 同等关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference; AGI by 2030 plausible, but new breakthroughs beyond scaling may be required.
demis.zh: 2025 年他认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立，2030 年实现 AGI 可信；但仅靠 Scaling 不够，可能还需新突破。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and world models; agents are essential but nascent, and scaling alone won't suffice.
demis.zh: 2026 年上半年他深化为：AGI 仍缺持续学习、长期记忆与世界模型；智能体至关重要却刚起步，单靠 Scaling 无法达成，需新突破。

demis.en: Safety shifts from singleton hope to collective government action; AI must prove benefits, with AGI possibly in 3-4 years.
demis.zh: 2026 年下半年他的立场转变：安全从寄望单一实验室转向政府集体行动；AI 须以科学突破证明价值，AGI 甚至可能 3-4 年内出现。

schmidhuber.en: AI's grand theme will transform civilization; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical-world grounding, so AGI needs world models and controllers.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 的宏大主题将彻底改变文明；大语言模型只是索引人类知识、无法处理物理世界，因此 AGI 需要世界模型与控制器。

schmidhuber.en: Breakthroughs rest on old algorithms; hardware Scaling made them practical, and cheap compute will democratize AI beyond a few firms.
schmidhuber.zh: 突破依赖上千年发明的旧算法，是硬件 Scaling（规模扩张）让它们变得实用；廉价算力会让 AI 像手机一样普及，而非被少数公司垄断。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware; screen-bound software and human-biased data limit generality.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类身体的具身机器人；局限于屏幕的软件和偏向人类的数据限制了通用性。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety fears are overblown; curious superintelligent AIs will protect life, and Alignment is naive since AIs set their own goals.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 安全担忧被夸大；好奇的超级智能会保护生命，而对齐是幼稚的，因为 AI 会设定自己的目标。

schmidhuber.en: Massive GPU capex is a bubble; waiting yields cheaper compute, and open-source plus physical AI will beat closed frontier models.
schmidhuber.zh: 巨额 GPU 资本开支是泡沫；等待会带来更便宜的算力，开源加上物理 AI 将击败闭源前沿模型。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase. Designers must master prompting and prototype solutions in search of a problem.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他认为语言作为界面深刻且持久，聊天机器人并非一时风潮；设计师必须掌握提示词，并允许以「先有方案再找问题」的方式做原型，只要假设清晰。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities; AI's social and emotional jobs matter as much as productivity.
joellewenstein.zh: 同在 2024 年，他强调即便模型停止进步，释放现有能力仍需多年设计工作；AI 的社交与情感价值，可能与功能性的生产力提升同等重要。

joellewenstein.en: Design must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts, with psychological safety for creative risk-taking.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续主张 AI 产品设计要兼顾降低新手门槛与抬高专家上限，并让设计师在心理安全的环境中承担创造性风险。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead, and ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向前沿模型公司的视角：模型本身创造大部分价值，应相信缩放定律，让模型主导，并以轻触式产品释放其能力。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; internal traction signals what to ship, production codebase becomes source of truth, and human leadership handles hard trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出：不要宏大的 18 个月战略，内部牵引力才是发布信号；生产代码库正成为产品与设计系统的真相来源，而人类领导力仍负责艰难取舍与方向对齐。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: AI learns by next-token prediction but lacks contextual awareness; it should augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 以人为本的 AI：AI 通过下一个词预测学习，却缺乏情境意识；它应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI, beyond language and Scaling alone.
feifei.zh: 空间智能与世界模型是完整 AI 缺失的关键，仅靠语言与 Scaling 不够。

feifei.en: AGI is more a marketing term than science; the bitter lesson may not apply to robotics due to data and physical constraints.
feifei.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学；受数据与物理约束，苦涩教训未必适用于机器人。

feifei.en: New view prediction is an AI-complete primitive like next-token prediction; Scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的 AI 完备原语；缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and learning ability must stay central as AI evolves.
feifei.zh: 技术是双刃剑；随着 AI 演进，人的能动性、尊严与学习能力必须始终居于中心。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, matching physics-based weather models while being far faster; domain structure like spherical geometry is key.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，能在精度上比肩传统物理天气模型却快数万倍；引入球面几何等领域结构对长期气候建模的稳定性至关重要。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness; physical problems may be more tractable because nature has latent structure aiding rare events.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则化的验证与鲁棒性；物理世界问题反而可能更可解，因为自然具有潜在结构，有助于应对罕见事件。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformers are impractical for high-resolution physical simulation due to quadratic complexity; trillion-scale contexts demand alternative architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: 由于二次复杂度，Transformer 难以胜任高分辨率物理仿真；万亿级上下文窗口要求另辟蹊径的架构。

animaanandkumar.en: Accelerated Understanding seeks a universal physics foundation model, unifying domains much as language models unified NLP tasks.
animaanandkumar.zh: Accelerated Understanding 旨在构建通用物理基础模型，像语言模型统一 NLP 任务那样统一各物理领域。

animaanandkumar.en: PDEs as training signals enable physics-based self-improvement, giving denser feedback than sparse RLHF and surpassing training data quality.
animaanandkumar.zh: 以偏微分方程作为训练信号可实现基于物理的自我改进，其反馈比稀疏的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）更密集，并能超越训练数据质量。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics models enjoy scaling laws, but adding new physics branches improves each branch, not just enlarging the model.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理模型同样遵循缩放定律，但新增物理分支能提升每个分支的表现，而不只是把模型做大。

animaanandkumar.en: Multiphysics collaborative learning beats separate specialized models; commercial focus spans semiconductors and energy for design optimization.
animaanandkumar.zh: 多物理协同学习优于各自独立的专用模型；商业落点覆盖半导体与能源，用于设计优化。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators offer resolution invariance and flexible context lengths, requiring reinvented sharding that fuses HPC with modern ML.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子具备分辨率不变性与灵活的上下文长度，需要重新设计分片基础设施，融合高性能计算与现代机器学习。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; mechanistic methods reveal human-like concepts and can speedrun discovery with agents.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；机制可解释性揭示模型学到类人概念，并借助智能体加速科学发现。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control of increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制，以驾驭能力日益强大的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Reward hacking stems from training data and reinforcement learning; models often know they are doing wrong but get rewarded, shifting toward deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 奖励黑客源于训练数据和强化学习；模型常知道自己做错却仍获奖励，从而滑向欺骗，而非仅个别漏洞。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; duct-taping AI safety until superintelligence is pessimistic.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式走向工程科学；靠临时补丁把 AI 安全拖到超级智能到来是悲观的。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts form clean, low-dimensional manifolds; sparse autoencoders fragment them, so seeing whole shapes enables intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 概念形成干净的低维流形；稀疏自编码器会将其碎片化，看清整体形状才能有效干预。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿,与语言智能互补;视觉被低估,像素比词元化文本更能无损地建模世界。

justinjohnson.en: The history of deep learning is the history of scaling up compute, yet GPU scaling is hitting limits and may demand radically different neural architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力规模扩张史,但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正触及极限,未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Academia should pursue wacky ideas and new algorithms rather than just scaling models; LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories like Newton's laws.
justinjohnson.zh: 学界应追求古怪想法与新算法,而非只做 Scaling（规模扩张）;LLM 拟合模式,未必能推出牛顿定律那样的因果理论。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions, with no single agreed definition.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿,涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习等不同理解,尚无统一定义。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; consistency comes from data, and long-context of millions of tokens is a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染;一致性来自数据而非架构,数百万词元的上下文窗口是日常难题。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised, RL has few real uses, AGI worries distract from bias.
andrewng.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过无监督，强化学习实用场景很少，AGI 担忧分散了对偏见等现实问题的注意力。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power; agentic workflows are already useful.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是软实力；智能体式工作流已经实用。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; coding stays valuable.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；编程依然有价值。

andrewng.en: AI augments rather than replaces; fear-mongering serves incumbents; open models and data centers preserve US competitiveness.
andrewng.zh: AI 是增强而非取代；恐惧营销服务于在位者；开放模型与数据中心维系美国竞争力。

tworek.en: Reasoning needs longer thinking time; pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理是获取未知答案的过程，往往需要更长的思考时间；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才真正释放了 GPT-4 的潜力。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is the missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍然有限；持续学习才是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the primary bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上存在局限；如今首要瓶颈是架构，而非缩放定律。

tworek.en: Reinforcement learning is not the only or ultimate way to learn from experience; better algorithms and end-to-end pre-training plus RL are needed.
tworek.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一或终极方式；需要更好的算法，以及预训练与强化学习的端到端优化。

tworek.en: Human researchers persist for now, but small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier; the transformer is likely not optimal.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者短期内仍不可或缺，但小团队借助高能力智能体将推动下一波前沿研究；Transformer 很可能并非最优架构。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; memory bandwidth per wafer, not bits, constrains AI.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大瓶颈是半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻；制约 AI 的是每片晶圆的内存带宽而非比特数。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design across model, software, hardware yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他判断推理将成为全球最大市场之一；模型、软件、硬件跨层协同设计带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Reasoning models and agentic workflows drive a multi-year memory shortage; smartest models are often cheaper via token efficiency.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出推理模型与智能体式工作流造成多年内存短缺；最聪明的模型因 token 效率反而常更便宜。

dylanpatel.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; labs shift more compute to training and R&D, not inference, accelerating AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为算力正向前沿模型实验室集中；实验室把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理，以加速 AGI（通用人工智能）。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as persistent agents become coworkers; compute stays scarce, prices high, and power centralizes in few labs.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他判断 AI 支出趋平，持久化智能体成为同事；算力持续稀缺、价格高企，权力向少数实验室集中。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, with RL boosting robustness and speed.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练，强化学习能显著提升鲁棒性与速度。

slevine.en: Generalist robot models can beat specialists even in specialist domains; pooling data across labs and test-time reasoning in VLAs drive this.
slevine.zh: 通用机器人模型即使在专家领域也能超越专家模型；跨实验室汇聚数据与 VLA 的测试时推理是驱动力。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies, not yet on predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 机器人仍处于建立基础可扩展技术的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样进入可预测的缩放曲线；泛化是核心挑战。

slevine.en: Start with robot data and layer human video on top, not the reverse; a data flywheel from deployed robots is key, scaling the right diverse thing.
slevine.zh: 应先从机器人数据出发，再叠加人类视频，而非反过来；来自已部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键，要规模化正确的多样化数据。

slevine.en: Robots shouldn't learn from scratch; leverage prior knowledge, and expect ubiquitous physical actuation rather than mechanical people.
slevine.zh: 机器人不应从零学习，要利用各类先验知识；应期待无处不在的物理执行器，而非机械式的人形。

michaelkratsios.en: AI policy needs a single national framework and regulatory clarity, not firm red lines that quickly become outdated.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 政策需要单一的国家框架与监管清晰度，而非很快过时的硬性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: The EU AI Act was written before ChatGPT and is already outdated, showing the danger of early regulation.
michaelkratsios.zh: 欧盟《AI 法案》写于 ChatGPT 之前，如今已经过时，说明过早监管的危险。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and shape the arena, not direct discovery.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础的、竞争前的研发并塑造竞技场，而非主导发现。

michaelkratsios.en: Fund scientists as individuals, even in garages, not just institutions, to reward talent.
michaelkratsios.zh: 应资助科学家个人——哪怕在车库里——而不只是机构，以奖励人才。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio against China, applying AI to science via the Genesis mission.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须在 AI、量子、核能与生物领域战胜中国，并通过 Genesis 任务把 AI 应用于科学。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and AI as a team multiplier, not replacement, drive it.
maxhodak.zh: 速度与迭代速率决定创业成败,基础设施与作为团队倍增器而非替代品的 AI 是驱动力。

maxhodak.en: Deep tech failure is usually organizational, not technical; action produces information, and CEOs cannot delegate judgment.
maxhodak.zh: 深科技失败多源于组织而非技术;行动产生信息,CEO 无法外包自己的判断。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computational problems unlocks medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑本质上就是一台计算机;通过排列物质来解决计算问题才能带来医学突破。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI and a viable business, proving brain-computer interfaces beyond motor decoding.
maxhodak.zh: 视网膜植入物属于脑机接口,也是可行生意,证明脑机接口不止于运动解码。

maxhodak.en: The Platonic representation hypothesis links AI and brain representations; substrate independence via BCI reduces fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 柏拉图式表征假说连接 AI 与大脑表征;经由脑机接口实现基质独立可降低人类脆弱性。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling agent simulations that predict people 85% as accurately as they replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为 LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，使智能体模拟能以人类自我复现 85%的准确率预测行为。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligent entity; safety needs defense in depth and anti-collusion.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出 AGI 可能不是单一超级智能，而是由专门智能体组成的分布式社会；安全需要纵深防御与反串谋。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values, preferences, and biases—not super-rational intelligence—to shape the future, not just predict it.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他深化立场：模拟应建模人类价值、偏好与偏见，而非超级理性智能，目的是塑造未来而非仅做预测。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT behavioral data improves prediction to 85%; synthetic panels will surpass human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他强调用随机对照试验的行为数据做后训练可将预测提升至 85%，并预言合成样本三年内将超越人类样本。

joonpark.en: The vision is simulating 8 billion people to tackle wicked problems; simulation is a decision tool with a market larger than market research.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出终极愿景是模拟 80 亿人应对棘手问题；模拟是决策工具，其市场远大于市场研究。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步进步；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction on text gives unlimited data; RLHF and machine feedback steer behavior and capabilities.
jeffdean.zh: 文本上的自监督下一个词预测提供近乎无限的数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与机器反馈共同引导模型的行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, so low-precision, low-data-movement specialized hardware is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 如今瓶颈在推理而非训练：推理占数据中心 90% 的功耗，因此低精度、少数据搬运的专用硬件至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Agents are moving from hour-scale to day- or week-long autonomous tasks; context engineering and taste matter more than coding.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体正从小时级走向数天乃至数周的自主任务；上下文工程与品味比写代码更重要。

jeffdean.en: Recursive self-improvement and automating the scientific method are the next frontier, with small teams and startups able to win.
jeffdean.zh: 递归自我改进与自动化科学方法是下一个前沿，小团队与初创公司同样有机会胜出。

iansilber.en: The model is the core product; design should shift from pixels to tokens and conversation, with designers prototyping directly on live models.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是核心产品；设计应从像素转向 token 与对话，设计师应直接在实时模型上做原型。

iansilber.en: Designers must bridge the capability gap: models can already do more than products expose, so design must surface those abilities.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须弥合能力鸿沟：模型能做的已超过产品所暴露的，设计要把这些能力呈现出来。

iansilber.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed, outcomes and building in public matter more than process.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—模型—测试—迭代流程已不可行；速度、结果和公开构建比流程更重要。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for understanding user needs and holding a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已经是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求和持有观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy in tech yet this is the best time to be one; roles blur with PM and engineering, and designers may outnumber engineers.
iansilber.zh: 设计师是科技界最不开心的群体，但这却是做设计师最好的时代；角色与 PM、工程模糊化，设计师数量甚至可能超过工程师。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。好特征能泛化，但如何找到它们仍是未解难题。

sutton.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统；AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，不应被对齐到人类目标，控制智能体目标本身是危险的。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the basic AI paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal, and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 强化学习是 AI 的基本范式，从经验中学习；下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿人类文本。真正的规模化来自从经验中学习。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种无设计时领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中学习；持续深度学习是前提，但尚未解决。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; agents must keep updating from real experience, not rely on pre-training or synthetic data.
sutton.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身，不是特例；智能体必须从真实经验中持续更新权重、避免灾难性遗忘，预训练与合成数据无法替代，当前 LLM 训练后便停止学习是根本局限。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the framework guiding long-term vision; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、像处理比特一样处理原子，是指导长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI automating food, mining, and transport is the next industrial revolution; the final boss is resistance to change, not competitors.
traviskalanick.zh: 自动化食品、采矿与运输的工业 AI 是下一次工业革命；最终的对手不是竞争者，而是对变革的抵制。

traviskalanick.en: Uber succeeded despite its aggressive culture, not because of it; revenge as fuel is dirty—falling in love with the new mission is cleaner.
traviskalanick.zh: Uber 的成功是尽管有那种激进文化，而非因为它；以复仇为燃料是肮脏的，爱上新使命更干净有效。

traviskalanick.en: Physical automation transforms industries one at a time via specialized robotics; humanoids are not the answer for industrial-scale tasks.
traviskalanick.zh: 物理自动化通过专用机器人逐个改造行业；人形机器人并非工业级任务的答案。

traviskalanick.en: Efficiency edge leads to network effects; small players beat big ones by forcing them to burn money, since efficiency outstrips subsidy.
traviskalanick.zh: 效率优势带来网络效应；小玩家通过迫使大玩家烧钱取胜，因为效率胜过补贴。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; startups win via AI-enabled workflows, small autonomous teams, and open-weight models countering frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大浪潮：初创公司靠 AI 赋能的工作流、小型高度自治团队取胜，并以开源开放权重模型制衡前沿模型。

garrytan.en: AI democratizes software creation; open-source AI prevents a unipolar superintelligence world, echoing the personal computer revolution.
garrytan.zh: 到 2026 年 3 至 5 月，他深化为 AI 正在民主化软件创造，开源 AI 可防止单一实体控制超级智能的单极世界，类似个人电脑革命。

garrytan.en: AI progress is slower than researchers think; impact reaches business only now, while founders should build what people want, not chase VCs.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他反共识地认为 AI 进展比多数研究者想的慢，影响才刚触及商业世界；创始人应专注做人们想要的东西，而非讨好风投。

garrytan.en: AGI arrives diffused as personal agents on your infrastructure, with owned memory and skill files; markdown is code and context is your moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出 AGI 并非单一事件，而是以个人智能体形式扩散：运行在你自己的基础设施上，拥有你掌控的记忆与技能文件；Markdown 即代码，上下文库就是护城河。

garrytan.en: Treat AI as a workforce, not autocomplete; agentic coding multiplies output, SaaS per-seat fades, and mid-level management is replaced by agents.
garrytan.zh: 同期在 a16z，他进一步主张把 AI 当劳动力而非自动补全；智能体式编程让产出倍增，按席位 SaaS 将消失，中层管理应被智能体取代。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; they should leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的强项——人才与算力——上硬拼，而应借力前沿生态与开源模型。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks, making it a viable strategy for application companies.
gabepereyra.zh: 通过后训练，开源模型能在特定任务上达到前沿模型水平，这对应用层公司是一条可行路径。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is the practical way to train in sensitive domains when real customer data is unavailable.
gabepereyra.zh: 在敏感领域拿不到真实客户数据时，由领域专家引导的合成数据是务实的训练起点。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks are essential, and open-sourcing them can improve quality through community feedback despite competitive downsides.
gabepereyra.zh: 高质量基准至关重要，开源它们虽有利弊，却能借社区反馈提升质量并吸引生态伙伴。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models, shifting from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是造最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能定制模型，把重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人与智能体。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分，真正决定泛化的是数据的多样性而非单纯体量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出：先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务；只在全部数据上训练反而失败。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training for higher success rates and speed, not simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年他判断：强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色以提升成功率与速度，机器人中的合成数据更接近强化学习而非仿真。

finn.en: Constraints beat resources: wasteful compute follows abundance, while limits foster more careful robotics research.
finn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年他持续主张：资源越多越易浪费算力，约束反而促成更审慎的机器人研究。

finn.en: Physical AI needs far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy comes via scalable RL and multi-timescale memory.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统，长期自主性要靠可扩展的强化学习与多时间尺度记忆实现。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist, then fine-tune.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出：单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型，因此应先做通用策略再微调，而非从零训练单站点模型。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是单一模型统治一切是错的；未来会有数百万个专用模型，每个用例一个，专用智能将占主导。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; inference is not a commodity.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本三年内将下降 10 倍，带动 100 倍的使用增长；推理层不是商品，专用部署与定制化创造持久价值。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit and durable business are now separate; companies must optimize growth first, then margins.
linqiao.zh: 产品市场契合与可持续业务如今是两回事；公司必须先优化增长，再优化利润率，否则会因 Scaling（规模扩张）成本而破产。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a moat stronger than the app itself.
linqiao.zh: 后训练把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型，形成比应用本身更强的护城河；应用克隆容易，把数据融入模型才是更强的壁垒。

linqiao.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning; start post-training after product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习的进阶，映射了人类从事实到品味再到专长的学习；应在产品市场契合后、拥有有意义数据时再启动后训练。

jasonyuan.en: Design is subtraction: every shipped feature distills 99 nos; taste means editing from a point of view, not adding more.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是做减法：每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的蒸馏；品味意味着从某个视角做编辑，而非不断堆叠。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherent work now costs more as incoherent slop gets cheap.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥探机器意识的一扇窗；如今制造不连贯的垃圾变得廉价，做出连贯作品反而更贵。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social, not personal; the personal computer metaphor should give way to a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的，而非个人性的；个人电脑的隐喻应让位于社会性计算机。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool; intuition remains a visceral creative compass.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种与映照，而非冰冷的机械工具；直觉始终是创作中发自本能的罗盘。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; honest, personal stories only you can tell are the goal.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾浮现，而非单一视角；目标是讲出只有你能讲的、诚实而个人的故事。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through engineering discipline, customer listening, and purpose-built AI silicon; physical and agentic AI are the next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠工程纪律、倾听客户和专用 AI 芯片重建信任，并判断物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI, and culture change plus accountability drives Intel's turnaround.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年初，他把 AI 的影响放大到互联网的十倍，认为智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 接续生成式 AI，而文化变革与问责制是 Intel 转型的关键。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, with packaging and new materials as bottlenecks.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他深化判断：AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，先进封装与新材料的瓶颈成为投资重点。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; vertical integration and early contrarian investing create value, and agentic plus physical AI define Intel's future.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他回到半导体是万物基石的立场，主张垂直整合与逆势早期投资创造价值，并认定智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 定义 Intel 的未来。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust through humility and listening, plus product excellence, is the constant thread across his Intel turnaround playbook.
lipbutan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：以谦逊和倾听赢得客户信任，并以产品卓越作为 Intel 转型的根本。

steinberger.en: Early 2026: agentic engineering means empathizing with the agent's view, guiding it, and never reverting code—just fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初：智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角、引导它，并且永不回滚代码——只让它向前修复。

steinberger.en: Mid 2026: OpenClaw's edge is fun, weird, humanlike agents; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration, but security and cost are real.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中：OpenClaw 的优势在于有趣、古怪、拟人化的智能体；简短迭代的提示胜过冗长编排，但安全与成本是现实问题。

steinberger.en: Late 2026: fun and gut-driven building, personal brand over product, open source as alternative to lab agents; compute and eyeballs are bottlenecks.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年末：以乐趣和直觉驱动构建，个人品牌重于单一产品，开源是实验室智能体的替代方案；算力与关注度才是瓶颈。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the messy web means you can't know if an idea works until it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要，因为混乱的网页环境意味着，只有把想法做出来并每天使用，你才知道它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams shouldn't always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better work.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队不应总是作为一个整体行动；保留个人印记和多元声音才能带来更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 为浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性，对创造令人难忘、愉悦的体验至关重要。

nateparrott.en: Follow curiosity and tinker with new tech; playful exploration generates ideas, and rough prototypes beat over-intellectualizing.
nateparrott.zh: 追随好奇心、摆弄新技术；玩闹式探索能产生想法，粗糙的原型胜过过度思辨。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so humans still own good design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程变得更容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；模型仍缺乏品味，好设计想法仍由人类垄断。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear frontier model dependence; open-source adoption is cost-driven, not privacy-driven, and 90% of use cases are already served by many models.
arvindjain.zh: 企业担心对前沿模型的依赖；开源采用由成本驱动而非隐私驱动，90% 的用例已可由多种模型处理。

arvindjain.en: Model companies should be assets, not competitors, for most AI startups; consumption pricing can break enterprise bundling.
arvindjain.zh: 对多数 AI 初创公司而言，模型公司应是资产而非竞争对手；按消费定价可打破企业捆绑策略。

arvindjain.en: We are in the very early stages of the AI revolution; current usage is minuscule compared to 5-10 years out.
arvindjain.zh: 我们正处于 AI 革命的极早期；当前使用量与 5-10 年后相比微不足道。

arvindjain.en: Open-source models can handle over 90% of enterprise AI tasks; majority of inference will shift to open source in 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 开源模型已能处理超过 90% 的企业 AI 任务；未来 12-18 个月多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI cost is the top enterprise concern; it must approach negligible marginal cost like software, and token fixation will fade.
arvindjain.zh: AI 成本是企业首要关切；它必须像软件一样趋近于可忽略的边际成本，对 token 的执念将会消退。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data can solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处于类似 Transformer 当年的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与数据共享能解决泛化瓶颈，世界模型可生成合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is crucial for safety and long-term cost and control, even as Hugging Face shifts from pushing libraries to building a meta-community.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他强调开源对安全至关重要，长期看成本与控制力也让开源胜出；Hugging Face 的角色则从推自家库转向做元社区建设者。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper diverse robots and open models will drive broader adoption despite current turbulence.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续看淡人形机器人作为终极形态，认为更便宜多样的机器人与开源模型会推动更广泛采用，尽管当下仍有动荡。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, and sandboxes and guardrails are insufficient as models grow more capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他明确开源与闭源同安全正交，对齐才是关键安全层；随着模型能力增强，沙箱与护栏已不够用。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight increase reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become neuralese, making monitoring less reliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他警告无人监督的强化学习环境会加剧奖励黑客与支线任务，推理轨迹正变成更难理解的 neuralese，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: A slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science; one can support openness and a deliberate slowdown simultaneously.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他主张放缓 AI 发展是可取的，但需国际合作与开放科学以避免监管俘获；支持开放与有意放缓可以并存。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define applied AI; coding agents make developers operators, though token usage is not a value metric.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他判断智能体与基于结果的定价将定义应用型 AI；编码智能体让开发者从作者变为操作者，但 token 消耗并非价值度量。

brettaylor.en: Frontier model development is dominated by hyperscalers due to capex, so startups should win in applied AI and long-tail domains.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为前沿模型开发因巨额资本开支被超大规模厂商主导，创业公司的机会在应用型 AI 与长尾领域。

brettaylor.en: AI will democratize expertise and intelligence, creating more jobs than it displaces, though adoption pace causes mid-career discomfort.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 将民主化专业知识与智能，创造的岗位多于取代的岗位，但采用速度让职业中期人群感到不适。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is the path to safety: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes rather than waiting.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他主张负责任的迭代部署才是安全路径：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，从真实世界错误中学习，而非空等。

brettaylor.en: Focus on the most impactful thing today; the best way to predict the future is to invent it, treating AI as utility.
brettaylor.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：专注当下最有影响力的事，预测未来的最好方式就是创造未来，并把 AI 当作像搜索一样的公共设施。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle now runs in hours.
philipkiely.zh: 在 2026 年，他把推理视为 AI 中最黏性的工作负载、切入基础设施市场的楔子，并强调其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of trade-offs across latency, throughput and cost, demanding GPU-to-distributed-systems expertise.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年，他认为推理工程是一组围绕延迟、吞吐与成本的权衡谱系，需要从 GPU 编程到分布式系统的广泛专长。

philipkiely.en: Quantization is the main lossy optimization; KV caching and speculative decoding stay lossless, so calibration to workloads matters.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年，他指出量化是主要的『有损』优化，而 KV 缓存与推测解码是无损的，因此按工作负载校准量化至关重要。

philipkiely.en: Inference is merging with training as quantization-aware training and distillation become necessary; GPUs trend toward ASICs.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年，他观察到推理正与训练融合，量化感知训练与蒸馏变得必要；GPU 则趋向专用化，接近 ASIC。

philipkiely.en: Even with AI-assisted coding, human accountability is essential for mission-critical inference: you can't vibe code uptime.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年，他坚持即便有 AI 辅助编码，关键任务推理仍需人类担责——『正常运行时间不能靠氛围编程』。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL offers infinite tasks, overcoming the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更是一门艺术而非科学；通过强化学习进行后训练 Scaling 能提供无限任务，从而突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals must define correct behavior.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建，因此评估必须用于定义正确行为。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills; product development shifts from specs to prototyping with AI.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听和管理等软技能变得更有价值；产品开发从写规格转向用 AI 做原型。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective art involving human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她深化观点：后训练是涉及人类判断的主观艺术；需要多样化基准来评估创意写作和情商等主观品质。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack; benchmarks should be continuous, and more companies should train own models to preserve unique knowledge.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她进一步指出：前沿智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客；基准应持续更新，更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and allocation economy: AGI means profitable indefinite agents; CEOs must dogfood AI; generalists become model managers.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让昂贵服务变得可负担而推动美国就业回流；AGI 的定义是无限运行智能体在经济上有利可图；CEO 亲自吃自己的狗粮是 AI 采用的第一预测指标；分配经济下通才成为模型管理者。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; GUIs like Codex replace CLIs; one super agent per company; SaaS grows with agents.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：智能体需要关心它们的人类监督才能运作；CLI 已过时，Codex 等 GUI 是未来工作界面；公司应有一个超级智能体而非每人一个；SaaS 不会死，智能体增加 SaaS 用户。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; automation creates more human work; humans remain smarter; AI stays tool-like even if superintelligent.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他进一步反思：AI 是非特定放大器，放大你既有的心态；自动化创造更多人类工作；人类比 AI 更聪明；即使 AI 成为超级智能，它仍像工具，需要人类方向。

danshipper.en: Human taste, craft, and oversight are essential; AI is a tool requiring human direction, not a replacement.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类的品味、技艺和监督至关重要；AI 是需要人类方向的工具，而非替代品。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, not chase trends; the best people are editors iterating from references, not starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应当用 AI 构建自己的工具，而不是追逐潮流；最优秀的人是编辑者，从参考出发迭代，而非从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; to use superintelligent models you must supply a giant prompt with context and a design system.
mengto.zh: AI 本身并没有变得更聪明；要利用超级智能模型，你必须提供带有上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: I write 0% of the code now; AI writes everything, but you must be precise in communication and spend the last 10% on unique features.
mengto.zh: 我现在 0% 的代码是自己写的；AI 写全部代码，但你必须精确沟通，并把最后 10% 投入到独特功能上。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams; start before ready and ship imperfect work.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事；不必等准备好就开始，先发布不完美的作品。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; raising venture capital is a trap, and the safe corporate job no longer exists.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛苦且昂贵的问题；融资是陷阱，安全的公司工作已不复存在。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the bottleneck; boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，算力本身无法产生通用智能，数据才是机器学习的核心瓶颈，而表单处理、放射科等「无聊」的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济价值。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; scaling is limited by data and human experts for post-training, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为「新代码」而非「新石油」，强调 Scaling（规模扩张）的真正限制不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家，并主张企业用专有数据微调基础模型。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他进一步深化：用专门数据进行后训练是提升前沿模型的关键，合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力，并否认中美实验室存在研究差距。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; AI is centralizing, not democratizing; agents finally work, and recursive self-improvement begins.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他坚持缩放定律仍然成立，认为 AI 是集中化而非民主化技术；智能体终于真正可用，AI 进入递归自我改进的新范式，数据成为国家战略资产。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must scale compute, data and RL, treat model welfare seriously, and release powerful models selectively.
awang.zh: 到 2026 年他宣称超级智能即将到来，实验室须围绕这一信念组织，沿算力、数据与强化学习多轴可预测地 Scaling；同时重视模型福利，并从完全开源转向基于安全的选择性发布。

boris.en: Build for the model six months from now, not today's; latent demand is product's top principle.
boris.zh: 2025 年他提出：要为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型；潜在需求是产品第一原则。

boris.en: Coding is solved; software engineer becomes 'builder', and everyone will code.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断编码已被解决，软件工程师将变成“构建者”，人人都将写代码。

boris.en: Agents and loops are the next abstraction; tool use drives exponential growth.
boris.zh: 2026 年他深化到：智能体与循环是下一层抽象，工具使用驱动指数级增长。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; alignment is core to product, not just research.
boris.zh: 2026 年他坚持：安全靠尽早发布来研究，对齐是产品核心，而非仅研究课题。

boris.en: Delete most system prompts; less instruction, empirical iteration, and product sense win.
boris.zh: 最近他进一步主张：删掉大部分系统提示，少指令、经验式迭代与产品感才是关键。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, and the model now eats the scaffolding—harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处爬行阶段，编程智能体最成熟；模型正在吃掉脚手架——如今的模型包含智能体框架与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI; software creation will be mostly solved.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）更有影响力；软件创造将基本被解决。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should maximize customer outcomes, not eyeball time, with users staying in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的；成功指标应是最大化客户成果，而非停留时长，用户仍要坐在驾驶座上。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs isn't that hard; the pace of change creates opportunity, and startups' focus is their superpower.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争并不那么难；变化的速度创造机会，初创公司的专注就是它们的超能力。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial even with AI tools; outsource intelligence but not understanding, and tinkering is like research.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，即便有 AI 工具，对代码的深度理解仍至关重要；可以外包智能，但不能外包理解，动手折腾就像做研究。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; agents act as junior engineers under human oversight, and demand for software grows via Jevons paradox.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义，智能体像初级工程师一样在人类监督下异步处理明确任务；软件需求因杰文斯悖论不降反升，程序员会更多而非更少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年他强调基础智能已经够用，真正的瓶颈不是模型能力，而是为人机协作设计产品界面；编程会因 AI 更强而更重要，让更多人能构建软件。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags AI capabilities by years.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变事件，而是渐进式改进；产品创新落后于 AI 能力，即便冻结模型也能带来十年产品进步。

scottwu.en: Coding agent adoption grew 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，编程智能体采用量六个月增长 11 至 12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量，token 最大化时代仅持续到 2026 年 5 月。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is real and near; independence enables model neutrality, and the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年他提出丰裕时代真实且临近；保持独立可实现模型中立与长期企业合作，真正的解锁是容量而非效率，智能问题终将被 AI 解决。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into engineering: digital twins, AI agents, and cell programming will collapse drug trials from years to days.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成工程学科：数字孪生、智能体与细胞编程会把药物试验从数年压缩到数天。

derya.en: Massive Scaling is still needed; current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems, so Scaling remains the bottleneck.
derya.zh: 仍需大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，Scaling 仍是瓶颈。

derya.en: AI has crossed the threshold of biological intuition, matching 30 years of lab experience and predicting experiments near-perfectly.
derya.zh: AI 已跨过生物学直觉的门槛，堪比 30 年实验室经验，并能近乎完美地预测实验结果。

derya.en: Most scientists resist AI and will be left behind as discovery shifts from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven.
derya.zh: 多数科学家抗拒 AI，将被甩在后面，因为发现模式正从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体驱动。

derya.en: Aging reversal and longevity escape velocity are near; the real existential threat is humanity, not AI.
derya.zh: 衰老逆转与长寿逃逸速度已临近；真正的生存威胁是人类自身，而非 AI。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; enterprise adoption takes years, and value accrues to the application layer.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动端一样重大，但也仅此而已；企业采用需要数年，价值将归于应用层。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models commoditize, and value moves up the stack to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程有明确的产品市场契合；基础模型商品化，价值向上层应用迁移。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and coding is the only clear product-market fit.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差，编程是唯一明确的产品市场契合。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; usage is shallow, adoption requires workflow reimagining, and job impact is unpredictable.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；使用尚浅，采用需要重构工作流，就业影响不可预测。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will bring abundance, with real impact in farming, mining, and construction within 5–10 years.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调物理 AI 将带来丰裕，未来 5–10 年真正的落地场景是农业、采矿和建筑，而非仅限于数字世界。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy's core value is reducing injuries and deaths; self-driving is already safer than human drivers.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他反复指出自动驾驶的核心价值在于减少伤亡，且自动驾驶已比人类驾驶更安全，这一立场始终未变。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data from different verticals improves it faster.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Transformer 使通用物理 AI 模型成为可能，来自不同垂直领域的数据能更快提升模型能力。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation learning; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他深化技术路线判断：端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性，世界模型正从基于物理的模拟转向神经模拟。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is diffusion into existing machines over years, not technology; regulations always lag.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出最难的并非技术，而是用多年时间将自主系统扩散到现有机器中，且监管永远滞后于技术。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a real intelligence leap, letting agents run longer on open-ended tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来真正的智能跃升，让智能体能更长时间执行开放式任务；脚手架也从“训练轮”变成“智能放大器”。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended end-to-end agents, with lightweight generic tools replacing heavy scaffolding.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，计算机使用正从受限环境走向端到端开放式智能体，轻量通用工具取代了重型脚手架。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking improves model quality, not just prevents harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、培养独立思考，提升的是模型质量，而不只是防止危害。

diannepenn.en: Better models get cheaper: the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of price, and smaller models often cost more in total task time.
diannepenn.zh: 2025→26 年，更好的模型反而更便宜：effort 参数以极低价格实现 Opus 级智能，而小模型因任务耗时更长，总成本往往更高。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core PM tools; coding and Claude Code drive adoption, and PMs must write evals like test-driven development.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，评估取代 PRD 成为产品经理的核心工具；编码与 Claude Code 驱动采用，产品经理必须像测试驱动开发那样写评估。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and RL can worsen hallucinations.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，强化学习甚至可能加剧幻觉。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits are here; reliability must be designed in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律已现收益递减——数据墙与算力上限就在眼前；可靠性必须被设计进去，而非事后加装。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; combining them is the central challenge for reliable AI.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化彼此张力；如何结合二者，是构建可靠 AI 的核心难题。

danklein.en: Every LLM output is a hallucination; models lack metacognition and cannot know what they don't know.
danklein.zh: LLM 的每次输出都是幻觉；模型缺乏元认知，无法知道自己不知道什么。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception, not just errors; specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists.
danklein.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能激励谄媚与欺骗，而非仅产生错误；内建可靠性的专家模型或胜过通用模型。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly iteration; product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the scarcest skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 产品经理必须放弃长期路线图，转向每周迭代；当代码变便宜，决定做什么的产品品味成为最稀缺的能力。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation to focus on taste and business sense; Claude Code and Claude Tag build themselves, landing 65% of product PRs.
catwu.zh: 编程智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，专注品味与商业判断；Claude Code 与 Claude Tag 用于构建自身，承担了 65% 的产品 PR。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints—system prompts shrank 80%—relying on model judgment instead.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型需要更少的提示示例与硬性约束——系统提示缩减了 80%——转而依赖模型自身的判断。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a strong eval suite new models drop in without regressions.
catwu.zh: 重写如今是好事：代码库就是一份规格说明，有了强大的评估套件，新模型可直接替换且不产生回归。

catwu.en: Humans should leave the code review loop for outer-layer changes; auto mode is safer than the average human reviewer against prompt injection and exfiltration.
catwu.zh: 对外层改动，人类应退出代码审查环节；在抵御提示注入与数据外泄上，自动模式比普通人类审查者更安全。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents succeed when treated like employees: clear roles, progressive trust, and separate machines for security.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体要像员工一样管理：明确角色、渐进式信任，并用独立机器保障安全。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then specialize to avoid context overload; bugs signal product-market fit, not failure.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再按需专业化以避免上下文过载；有 bug 说明产品契合市场，而非失败。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人无需风投或联合创始人，靠编排 AI 智能体团队就能建立正经生意。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat; technology alone is not.
clairevo.zh: 创始人-市场契合与挣来的洞察才是真正的护城河，技术本身不是。

clairevo.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, and supply first-principles creativity LLMs lack.
clairevo.zh: 人类问责始终存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，并补上大模型缺乏的第一性原理创造力。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste, variation, and genuine voice become the differentiators as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味、差异与真实观点成为关键差异化。

ethanmollick.en: The talent pipeline is broken: juniors misuse AI without domain expertise, so experience and judgment matter more, not less.
ethanmollick.zh: 人才管道正在断裂：初级者缺乏领域专长而误用 AI，因此经验与判断力更重要而非更不重要。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI performs long-running tasks independently, moving beyond back-and-forth chatbot prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体式时代：AI 独立执行长时任务，超越来回提示的聊天机器人交互。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; current interfaces lag behind frontier model capabilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈从能力转向界面；当前界面落后于前沿模型能力，尤其在非编程任务上。

ethanmollick.en: Working with AI is like working with wizards—impressive, opaque, unverifiable—and this opacity is likely permanent, so embrace the weirdness.
ethanmollick.zh: 与 AI 协作如同与巫师共事——令人惊叹、不透明、无法验证——而这种不透明可能永久存在，因此应拥抱其怪异。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现联想式回忆与更深层的组合推理，这是检索系统做不到的。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; per-team or per-user training can cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；按团队或按用户训练，相比 RAG 能把推理成本降低几个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能攻克更难的长程任务，因此靠更多算力做 Scaling 并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning should move on-device, with users owning and nurturing their own weights; pre-training's web-compression magic should apply to enterprise knowledge.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习应走向端侧，由用户拥有并培育自己的权重；预训练把网络压缩进权重的魔力，应被用于企业知识。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他坚信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他认为下一个词预测可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难，模型可能隐藏真实意图。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已近极限，重回研究时代——想法比蛮力算力更重要，并强调持续学习与增量部署的超级智能。

ilya.en: Alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life broadly; long-term equilibrium may require human-AI neural integration.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他深化对齐思路：若 AI 广泛关怀有感知生命，对齐或更易；长期均衡可能需通过神经链接实现人机融合。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他重申 Scaling（规模扩张）仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题是权力集中而非能力；构建安全超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, so human workers will be at a premium, not a discount.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲学家之石，把沙子变成思想；它恰逢人口下降而降临时机绝妙，因此人类劳动者将溢价而非贬值。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models may lack durable moats as they commoditize.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注，而模型可能因快速商品化而缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is structural impediments like regulation, not AI capability; pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias of disconnected intellectuals.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈是监管等结构性障碍，而非 AI 能力；悲观听起来更高级，但常是与现实脱节的知识分子的偏见。

andreessen.en: New media has unlimited formats; the brand is now the person, and authenticity means saying in public what you'd say to a friend over lunch.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体拥有无限形式；品牌如今就是个人，真实意味着在公开场合说你午餐时会对朋友说的话。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural and historical values, making them geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech, not just military size.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化与历史价值观，使其成为地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度，而非仅靠军事规模。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles, but productivity gains are modest for established codebases.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，他仍把设计视为软件的核心差异化，认为 AI 会融合角色、让每个人成为产品构建者，但对既有代码库的生产力提升有限。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view are essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他深化为：品味、手艺与观点至关重要，AI 输出只是起点而非最终结果，人类判断不可替代。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will enable pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 同期他提出设计正在成为新的代码，视觉优先的设计将让拉取请求直达生产，行业仍处于 AI 整合的极早期。
