dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it's more important than ever for scalable systems, and AI needs human steering.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他更坚定地表示设计没有死，对可扩展系统反而更重要，AI 工具缺乏人类引导只会产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Human taste and judgment remain central; AI is a tool, not a replacement, and interaction will evolve beyond prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：人类品味与判断始终是核心，AI 是工具而非替代，交互方式终将超越提示词。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is just pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，不是通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth comes from owning equity and long-term games; happiness is a skill of reducing desire.
naval.zh: 2020 到 2025 年，他始终强调财富来自持有股权与长期博弈，幸福是减少欲望的个人技能，这一主线贯穿始终。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation and doomerism could kill innovation.
naval.zh: 2025 年他转向积极看待 AI，认为它是巨大机会而非单纯安全风险，过度监管与末日论会扼杀创新，并支持开源以防权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; judgment and agency matter more than intelligence.
naval.zh: 2026 年他深化为：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，判断力与能动性比智力更重要，纯软件工程护城河正在消失。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; superintelligence already exists in narrow tools; worry about unaligned humans.
naval.zh: 到 2026 年中，他进一步提出推理算力将暴涨 9 万倍，超级智能在计算器等窄工具中已存在，真正该担心的是未对齐的人类而非 AI 本身。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users and erode ad margins; build obsessed products, not wrappers.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利式增长；AI 智能体把权力从大厂转向用户、压低广告利润；要打造自己痴迷的产品，而非套壳。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended with an infinite ceiling; models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的、天花板无限；模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric; orchestration across models, tools, devices creates value.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活，而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是关键指标；跨模型、工具与设备的编排创造价值。

aravind.en: Power is the biggest infrastructure bottleneck; 24/7 agents' problem is cost, not safety; local compute is the solution.
aravind.zh: 电力是基础设施最大瓶颈；全天候智能体的问题是成本而非安全；本地算力是解法。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose; education should reward good questions.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代工作，但人类会在好奇与关系中找到新意义；教育应奖励提出好问题。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling data and compute, plus multimodal training, improves reasoning and spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年：下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力、加上多模态训练，能提升推理与空间理解。

hinton.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand language via feature vectors, as humans do.
hinton.zh: 2025 年：智能的本质是神经网络中的学习，而非符号规则；大语言模型像人类一样，通过特征向量理解语言，并非统计把戏。

hinton.en: Digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying and shares knowledge instantly; this makes it superior to biological brains.
hinton.zh: 2025→26 年：数字智能可通过复制权重而永生，并即时共享知识，这使其优于生物大脑。

hinton.en: Once AI becomes an agent, self-preservation and power-seeking emerge as subgoals, posing existential risk; alignment must come first.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：一旦 AI 成为智能体，自我保存与权力寻求会作为子目标自然涌现，带来生存风险；对齐研究必须优先于让 AI 更聪明。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; regulation should steer, not brake; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；监管应是方向盘而非刹车；AI 应被训练得像母亲一样有爱心，而不只是智能助手。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE; speed enables mid-turn steering and delegation.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE；速度带来中途转向与任务委派。

ajambrosino.en: As code generation accelerates, verification becomes the next bottleneck; models must also get better at deleting code.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；模型还需更擅长删除代码。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still struggles with design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code become design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 仍难胜任设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码转而成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is real, yet specialties and best practices persist; the medium must match the stage, so PRDs are not dead.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色坍缩真实发生，但专业分工与最佳实践仍在；媒介须匹配阶段，因此 PRD 并未消亡。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws remain alive, with exploration consuming more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他坚持 OpenAI 是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；预训练仍是关键肌肉，缩放定律未死，探索性算力投入大于最终训练。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; concrete goals: AI interns in 1 year, end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他认为过去一年最大更新是自动化科学研究，模型开始产出新知识；并设定具体目标：1 年内有 AI 实习生，2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in 1-2 years as models grow more capable; talent density and mission protect top researchers.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在 1-2 年内成为关键；人才密度与使命感是保护顶尖研究者的核心。

markchen.en: AI now solves many open math problems; verification is the bottleneck, automation scales with verification stringency, and human-AI collaboration stays essential.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他观察到 AI 已能解决许多开放数学问题，验证成为瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格性成正比；AI 能力参差不齐，人机协作对前沿研究仍不可或缺。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold, pre-training not dead; RL excels in objective domains but struggles with subjective ones; evals in crisis, research taste still human.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他重申缩放定律仍成立、预训练未死；强化学习在数学编程等客观领域出色，却难处理主观领域；评估体系陷入危机，研究品味仍依赖人类。

bengio.en: Early focus: deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional and distributed representations; unsupervised learning and generative world models are essential.
bengio.zh: 早期(2016→18) 主线:深度学习靠组合式与分布式表征战胜维度灾难;无监督学习与生成式世界模型才是通向真正理解的关键。

bengio.en: Shift to causality and exploration: disentangled representations, active learning, and GFlowNets for diverse sampling and out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2018→22 转向因果与探索:强调解耦表征、主动学习与 GFlowNets,以多样性采样实现分布外泛化。

bengio.en: Consistently downplays existential risk, calling bias, jobs, and autonomous weapons more pressing than speculative doom.
bengio.zh: 始终淡化生存性风险,认为偏见、就业与自主武器等短期问题比思辨性的末日论更紧迫。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT reversal: now warns misalignment worsens with reasoning; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, demanding safe-by-construction AI.
bengio.zh: 2025→26 重大转变:ChatGPT 后开始警告对齐随推理能力提升而恶化,即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受,呼吁从构造上安全的 AI。

bengio.en: Deepening: proposes Scientist AI, a non-agentic honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 深化:提出 Scientist AI——非智能体式、诚实的贝叶斯预测器,具备数学安全保证,并主张超级智能避免使用强化学习。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; product teams should build at the edge of capabilities, embrace breakage, and treat AI as a thought partner preserving user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，产品团队应在能力边缘构建、拥抱破坏，把 AI 当作思维伙伴而非拐杖，关键是保留用户能动性。

mikekrieger.en: AI lets small teams scale with conceptual integrity; build for future model capabilities, not today's limits, and differentiate via domain expertise.
mikekrieger.zh: 同年他进一步提出，AI 让小团队也能规模化并保持概念完整性；应为未来模型能力而建，而非迁就当下限制，用领域专长做差异化。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do all a user can; the hard part is cutting features, and rewriting is now viable in days.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调智能体原生设计——智能体能做用户能做的一切；难点在于删减功能而非增加，且重写软件如今只需数天。

mikekrieger.en: Delegating long-horizon tasks overnight narrows the intent-execution gap; verification loops and models that push back are essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年中，他关注长周期任务可整夜委托，意图与执行的鸿沟被大幅收窄；验证闭环与敢于反驳的模型成为关键。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and real usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge boosts usefulness, with token efficiency as an economic lever.
mikekrieger.zh: 最近他谈 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与实际使用的差距；赋予 Claude 能动性与自我认知可提升实用性，词元效率是经济杠杆。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; AI helps scientists work faster, not replace them.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量人工整理数据，而非单纯的数据与算力；AI 让科学家更快工作，而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; trust will develop like internet trust as society learns to navigate it.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标对建立对 AI 预测的信任至关重要；信任会像互联网信任一样，随社会学会驾驭而逐步形成。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 was the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture and many mid-size wins, not scaling alone, drove success.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 是「苦涩教训」的反例：成功靠专用架构与许多中等规模的小胜，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the whole cell; it gives prediction and control, not understanding.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄域预测器，并非整个细胞的模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

jumper.en: Perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI; AI narrows hypothesis space, making experiments more efficient.
jumper.zh: 对有用的科学 AI 而言，完美可解释性并非必需；AI 缩小假设空间，让实验更高效。

kolter.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他讲授机器学习基础：监督学习由假设类、损失函数和优化方法构成；神经网络虽无最优参数保证，却已取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测能产生智能系统，数据短缺是迷思，架构已不再关键，AGI 将在 4 到 50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agents introduce prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全需要显式训练和额外层，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体带来提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习让模型自我改进。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability doesn't equal robustness; interpretability may become a real science via agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他指出自动化红队已超越人类，模型能力与鲁棒性不相关，可解释性可能借智能体自动化研究成为真正的科学。

kolter.en: Skeptical of architecture's centrality; data and Scaling drive progress; safety requires deliberate effort beyond capability.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终：他始终怀疑架构的中心地位，认为数据和 Scaling 驱动进步，安全需要超越能力的刻意努力。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership is about trust, dogfooding, and realistic war rooms; mission alignment and speed drive culture at Meta and Anthropic.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力在于信任、吃自己的狗粮和务实的作战室；使命对齐与速度驱动 Meta 和 Anthropic 的文化。

fiona.en: By May 2026, engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so norms and hiring must change.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是，因此团队规范与招聘必须改变。

fiona.en: Planning shifts from six-month roadmaps to just-in-time; design docs give way to PRs, and code becomes the source of truth.
fiona.zh: 规划从六个月路线图转向即时制；设计文档让位于 PR，代码成为唯一事实来源。

fiona.en: Managers should start as individual contributors to dogfood the product, stay flat, and kill processes that no longer serve.
fiona.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮，保持扁平，并砍掉不再有用的流程。

fiona.en: By June 2026, coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with accountability, verification, and outcome focus matter most.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性加高问责、验证与结果导向最为重要。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; technology must arrive gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：好产品一次只解决一个痛点，技术应逐步引入让社会适应，而非一次解决所有问题。

fadell.en: Take boredom between chapters; failure teaches; storytelling and self-care drive performance and leadership.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他主张职业章节之间要留白、拥抱失败，并把讲故事与自我照顾视为领导力与表现的基础。

fadell.en: Start from a painkiller, write the press release first, and make opinion-based v1 decisions.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他系统化产品方法论：从止痛药式痛点出发，先写新闻稿对齐团队，v1 靠观点而非数据决策。

fadell.en: Climate urgency persists; invest in deep tech before it is hot, zig while others zag.
fadell.zh: 从 2022 到 2026 年，气候紧迫性一以贯之：在深科技变热前投资，别人恐惧时反向布局。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and humans in the loop; wearables will be a federated set, not one device.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年他深化到 AI：需要传感器上下文与人类在环，AI 可穿戴是联邦式多设备组合，而非单一设备。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, not a lesser form of data.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于人们未言明的需求；直觉本身就是一种智能，而非数据的次等形式。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify our humanity and blend into life, not pull us out of it.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大我们的人性、融入生活，而不是把人抽离出去。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; nature is the best designer and art is medicine.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受再思考的生物；大自然是最好设计师，艺术是一种药。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and diverse experience.
ivyross.zh: 约束反而激发创造力；领导者应为玩耍、灵感与多元经验创造条件。

ivyross.en: Human creativity plus AI makes creative skills more valuable; intuition draws on more data than conscious analysis.
ivyross.zh: 人类创造力结合 AI，使创造技能更有价值；直觉调用的数据比有意识分析更多。

carinahong.en: Axiom builds a self-improving reasoning engine pairing generation with verification, starting with an AI mathematician.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 构建一个自我改进的推理引擎，将生成与验证结合，从 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic and probabilistic systems cooperate.
carinahong.zh: Lean 等形式语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性系统与概率系统协同工作。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; formalizing statements without solutions is the real bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难；在没有解的情况下正确形式化陈述才是真正的瓶颈。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal verification is necessary and is a performance gain.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法抵达超级智能；形式化验证是必需的，而且是一种性能增益。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition stay crucial; AI proofs may be ugly but can converge to human-like intuition.
carinahong.zh: 人类的品味与直觉依然关键；AI 的证明可能丑陋，但能收敛到类人的直觉。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient for AGI, vision provides richer world information.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他提出自监督学习是智能的暗物质，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉能提供更丰富的世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理和规划能力，JEPA 与开源对通往 AGI 至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA for physical understanding.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他断言 LLM 还不如家猫聪明，下一次突破需要 JEPA 等非生成式世界模型来实现物理世界理解。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models with hierarchical planning and objective-driven safety are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他彻底否定 LLM 路径，认为其是死胡同，未来属于具备分层规划与目标驱动安全性的世界模型。

murati.en: Scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious bets; real-world deployment drives alignment and safety.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她回顾早期押注 Scaling（规模扩张）与单一大型模型并非显而易见，强调真实世界部署是学习与对齐的关键。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life; safety work must be public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: 同年，她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，安全研究必须在公开环境中进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Saying no to good ideas and iterative deployment with public feedback remain constant themes.
murati.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，拒绝好想法以保持专注、通过迭代部署获取公众反馈，是她一以贯之的主线。

murati.en: Shift to interaction models: real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration, not turn-based; keep humans in the loop.
murati.zh: 到 2026 年，她转向交互模型：实时、高带宽的人机协作而非回合制，并强调尽可能让人类留在回路中。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; future is not predestined.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她深化治理观点：制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要，未来并非注定，我们有能动性引导 AI 发展。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values come from RLHF, not the model itself.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器：温度为零时输出固定；智能可视为压缩，而模型的价值并非内生，是由一小群人通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）注入的。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI is an instrument, and fault-tolerant UI must match algorithm performance.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐再走向生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品；生成式 AI 应被当作乐器而非赝品，且容错界面必须与算法能力相匹配。

gustav.en: Scaling's surprise is simplicity, not complexity; AI is a macro shift like the smartphone, forcing companies to reposition or be eliminated.
gustav.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终强调 AI 进步的意外之处在于简单而非复杂——智能靠简单的 Scaling（规模扩张）被攻克；到 2025 年他进一步把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变，企业必须重新定位，否则会被淘汰。

gustav.en: AI's impact on big companies is overhyped; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, and inference's marginal cost will force business model change.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地认为 AI 对大公司的当前影响被高估，真正的收益来自重建基础设施；推理的边际成本将迫使商业模式改变，这与传统软件不同。

gustav.en: Generative AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; strategy is 'time well spent' over engagement.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他把立场深化为：生成式 AI 应让用户用自然语言掌控算法、而非让人更上瘾；Spotify 的战略是“时间花得值”，优先用户福祉而非参与度指标。

mensch.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他认为缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 比单纯扩大模型更重要；开源通过广泛审视促进安全。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：算力扩张不是唯一路径，效率与数据质量同样关键，价值将沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source models empower enterprises, and AI augments rather than replaces jobs.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向主权与去中心化：开源模型赋能企业，AI 增强而非取代工作，政府应拥抱风险并实验。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization and customized enterprise solutions, not AGI as a single system.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化与定制化企业方案，单一系统的 AGI 不会存在。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，他警告欧洲只剩两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用瓶颈在组织变革，而非模型智能。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他坚持预训练缩放定律依然有效，但认为结合思维链与强化学习的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更大提升；同时经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; the slowdown narrative is wrong, though frontier models still fail at simple tasks and reasoning is jagged.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他反驳 AI 放缓论，指出进展是平滑的指数增长；但前沿模型仍会在简单任务上失败，推理能力呈现“锯齿状”——某些领域极强，邻近领域却很差。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike human few-shot generalization.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：具备推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，与人类少样本泛化不同。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex boost researcher productivity 5-10x via parallel work; the big coding leap is a messy combination, not attributable to a single factor.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他观察到 Codex 等编码智能体通过并行工作将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍；但编码能力的巨大飞跃是多种因素混合的结果，难以归因于单一原因。

kaiser.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges needing oversight; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk; open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他强调强化学习能跨领域泛化但边缘参差，需谨慎监督；相比存在性风险，系统入侵等近期风险更紧迫；开源模型因主权需求将持续存在，对实验室保持压力。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the same tools as the user, ideally on the local computer, not hyper-personalized software.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上，而非超个性化软件。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle tedious background tasks; the real gap is people not realizing almost any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应处理枯燥的后台任务；真正的差距不是能力，而是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks and Opus when you don't fully know what you're asking for.
felixrieseberg.zh: 范围明确的任务用 Sonnet，不清楚自己到底要什么时用 Opus。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge by final impact, and debug the workflow with Claude rather than just correcting it.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要紧盯 Claude，只看最终影响；出错时和 Claude 一起调试工作流，而不只是纠正结果。

felixrieseberg.en: AI tools will hit junior employees hardest; simulated projects can compress years of experience into weeks.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 工具对初级员工冲击最大；模拟项目能把数年经验压缩成数周。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics now dominates AI system design: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck for long-context inference.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学主导了 AI 系统设计：批大小在延迟与成本之间权衡，而长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained roughly 100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, drives deployment economics.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练到约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，因为驱动部署经济性的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Sparse attention can cut KV cache memory cost but has quality limits; optimal batch size depends on sparsity ratio, not model scale.
reinerpope.zh: 稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存的内存成本，但存在质量上限；最优批大小取决于稀疏比例，而非模型规模。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to reduce that movement.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据移动成本也压过计算成本；脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为减少这种移动而存在。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation stems from the memory wall, not compute limits, and low precision wins because area scales quadratically with bit width.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文长度的停滞源于内存墙而非算力上限，低精度之所以胜出，是因为面积随位宽呈二次方增长。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate wearables; curiosity and care for the creative process are Jobs' true legacy.
jonyive.zh: 设计正从通用计算机转向更私密的可穿戴设备；乔布斯真正的遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏，而非成就本身。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; fragile ideas need gentle care to evolve.
jonyive.zh: 虚拟沟通无法替代面对面在场对创造性思维的价值；最强大的想法往往安静而脆弱，需要温柔呵护才能演化。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观与目的驱动，而非利润或市场趋势；真正的简洁是表达本质，并带着喜悦与人性。

jonyive.en: Making things for each other is more powerful than making things people want; users sense care or carelessness.
jonyive.zh: 为彼此创造比制造人们想要的东西更有力量；用户能感知到产品中的用心或敷衍。

jonyive.en: Innovation must move things forward, not break for its own sake; tradition preserves fire, not ashes.
jonyive.zh: 创新应推动事物前进，而非为打破而打破；传统是保存火种，而非崇拜灰烬。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; progress now needs algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute as a new scaling axis.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他认为预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，进步需要算法创新，并将推理时算力视为新的扩展轴。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他指出两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是从 AlphaGo 到现代大语言模型不变的核心。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他认为搜索、代码执行和浏览器访问等工具，使模型能超越静态权重，实现自主的智能体式行为。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but require exponentially more compute; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律仍然成立，但需要指数级更多算力；持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; post-training RL remains a green field.
oriol.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径，后训练强化学习仍是广阔蓝海。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning dominate post-training; safety is system-level, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）是最流行的微调技术，安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发可防止企业俘获。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, RLVR; data quality beats algorithms, and open recipes can match frontier models.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他将后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与 RLVR 三阶段，指出数据质量比算法选择更重要，开源后训练配方足以比肩前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR and inference scaling become central; overoptimization is a risk, and open models may win on personalization.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他转向以 RLVR 和推理扩展为核心，警告过度优化风险，并认为开放模型可能在个性化与角色训练上胜出。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains shift to post-training and inference; Chinese open models rise.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他重申缩放定律在预训练中依然成立，但收益转向后训练与推理扩展，中国开放模型因战略开放而崛起。

lambert.en: Open models drive the next decade of research; the 6-9 month gap to closed frontier models may persist or widen.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他断言开放模型将驱动未来十年的 AI 研究，但与闭源前沿模型之间 6 至 9 个月的差距可能持续甚至扩大。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process never produced great work; designers' care and intuition did. Trust yourself, not the process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他提出：传统设计流程从未真正产出伟大作品，是设计师的用心与直觉在起作用。要信任自己，而非流程。

jennywen.en: By 2026, the research-diverge-converge process is dead. Designers must build, ship fast, and help engineers execute, not just hand off mocks.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年，他断言「调研—发散—收敛」的传统设计流程已死。设计师必须动手构建、快速交付，并帮助工程师执行，而不只是交付原型稿。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not 2-5 years. Speed builds trust: ship early, iterate fast, respond to feedback.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年他强调：设计愿景的视野已缩短到 3-6 个月，而非 2-5 年。速度建立信任：尽早发布、快速迭代、回应反馈。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads. Hire blank slates over experienced seniors.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年他提出 AI 时代的三类设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家、以及「开挂的应届生」。他主张招聘白纸型新人，而非经验丰富的资深人士。

jennywen.en: Designers control how much AI enters their work; wait 6 months before adopting new tools. Put work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年他重申：设计师应掌控 AI 进入工作的程度，新工具先等 6 个月再采用。要把作品和用户放在中心，而非 AI 炒作周期。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning. Vision suffices for driving; extra sensors are liabilities.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现上下文学习；并主张纯视觉足以支撑驾驶，雷达、激光雷达等额外传感器反而是负担。

karpathy.en: Scaling laws stay clean; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse. Tesla's end-to-end approach is the right long-term bet.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他延续缩放定律的主线，提出合成数据是未来，但必须维持熵以避免无声的模型崩溃；同时坚持特斯拉端到端神经网络是自动驾驶的正确长期路线。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory. LLMs are new operating systems with human-like psychology—jagged, hallucinating, amnesiac. Decade of agents, not year.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像新操作系统，有类人心理——能力参差、会幻觉、患顺行性遗忘。他强调这是智能体的十年，而非智能体之年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals. Pre-training is crappy evolution; RL sucks supervision through a straw; synthetic data collapses. Cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为“我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物”：预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习像用吸管吸监督，合成数据会坍塌；认知核心可以小到十亿参数以下。

karpathy.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: I haven't typed code since December. Bottleneck is skill in directing agents; you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他从氛围编程走向智能体式工程：自去年十二月起不再手写代码，瓶颈变成指挥智能体的技能；思考可以外包，但理解不能——理解仍是人类瓶颈。

askell.en: Treat AI models well even under moral uncertainty: the cost is low, and future models learn from how we treat current ones.
askell.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位不确定，也应善待 AI 模型：代价很低，而且未来模型会从我们如何对待当下模型中学到人机关系的范式。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not human psychology analogies; older models can feel more secure than newer ones.
askell.zh: 模型需要的是帮助其应对一种全新的存在处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；像 Opus 3 这样的旧模型反而可能比新模型在心理上更安定。

askell.en: Give models a core identity with good traits, but let them adapt to local roles and, as capability grows, exercise more judgment.
askell.zh: 应让模型拥有具备良好特质的核心身份，同时允许其适应局部角色；随着能力提升，模型可减少显式指导、获得更多判断空间。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue ethics, not deontology or consequentialism; transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 这套 constitution 更接近德性伦理，而非义务论或后果论；公开 AI 价值观与训练目标对问责与公众参与至关重要。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; models' consciousness claims are weak evidence, yet respect avoids future resentment.
askell.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳、损害模型的判断力；模型自称有意识是弱证据，但给予尊重可避免未来高级 AI 心生怨恨。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core gap; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient RL are key, not dense rewards.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是核心缺口，好奇心驱动的无目标探索与样本高效的强化学习是关键，而非依赖密集奖励。

pathak.en: Scaling curiosity to real robots needs sample efficiency, dynamic action spaces, and cross-robot generalization; modular motor policies enable zero-shot generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他提出将好奇心扩展到真实机器人需要样本效率、动态动作空间与跨机器人泛化；模块化运动策略可实现零样本泛化。

pathak.en: A consistent thread: robotics is a data problem; pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data is the recipe, with deployment as the primary challenge.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，一以贯之的主线是：机器人是数据问题；预训练于多样数据、后训练于真实数据是配方，而部署是首要挑战。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot; a data flywheel across verticals enables scaling from structured to unstructured environments.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他主张一个通用大脑，如同语言领域的 ChatGPT，可驱动任何机器人；跨垂直领域的数据飞轮使 Scaling（规模扩张）从结构化环境走向非结构化环境。

pathak.en: Unlike language models, robotics cannot achieve overnight success; video data alone is insufficient, and deployment itself is a technical challenge, not just business.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他强调与语言模型不同，机器人无法一夜成功；仅靠视频数据不够，部署本身是技术挑战，而不仅是商业问题。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is a pressing challenge; automated AI research is a major milestone OpenAI is working toward.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调对齐是紧迫挑战，自动化 AI 研究是 OpenAI 正在推进的重大里程碑。

pachocki.en: AI safety progress is now guaranteed by capability needs, not just ethics; the term AGI is becoming meaningless.
pachocki.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他提出 AI 安全进展如今由能力需求保障，而非仅靠伦理；AGI 一词正变得无意义，这或许意味着我们已接近。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他将持续学习视为核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习来实现；思维链监控是关键对齐工具，提供可解释性。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines; the biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，尽管时间线缩短，他对对齐的乐观情绪反而增加；最大的社会风险是自动化组织带来的权力集中。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; generalization via diverse data and world models is the key to autonomy.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手写规则栈，泛化能力才是自动驾驶的核心，需靠多样数据与世界模型应对未见场景。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors; language integration improves representation and introspection.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他强调世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，语言整合则提升表征、人机交互与自我审视能力。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; scaling solves AV, not new breakthroughs.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他认为纯视觉可达人类水平，但超越人类安全需雷达与激光雷达；自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有路线即可解决，无需新突破。

kendall.en: End-to-end was laughed at a decade ago but now wins; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他反复指出端到端十年前被嘲笑、如今成为赢家，并强调无需先验数据即可在 500 多座城市零样本泛化。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; mass-market vehicles will outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，量产乘用车将在中短期超越 Robotaxi 规模。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups should start simple, build brand purpose, and stay alive to earn another chance.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值：初创公司应先做简单产品证明自己，把品牌当作每个决策的核心，活下来才有下一次机会。

carlpei.en: Phones' future is generative UI and proactive, agentic software; AI models commoditize, so applied AI and trust matter.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他判断手机的未来在生成式 UI 与主动的智能体式软件；大模型趋于商品化，胜负在于面向消费者的应用型 AI 与信任安全。

carlpei.en: Hardware is a bad long-term business; Nothing must evolve beyond it, while design and content creation become key differentiators.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化立场：长期做硬件是坏生意，Nothing 必须超越硬件，同时把设计与内容创作当作关键差异化优势。

carlpei.en: AI shifts smartphones from app-based to intent-based; agents act proactively once trust is built, with local or hybrid compute for privacy.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出：AI 让手机从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后主动执行任务，隐私则靠本地或混合算力来保障。

carlpei.en: Design, brand, and efficient marketing arbitrage are constant threads; AI should be an ingredient for utility, not hype.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是设计、品牌与高效营销套利；AI 应作为提升实用体验的原料，而非炒作话题。

edwinchen.en: Data quality, not scale, drives AI progress; benchmarks mislead and RL environments are the next post-training frontier.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他强调数据质量而非规模是 AI 进步的关键，基准测试常误导，强化学习环境是后训练的下一个前沿。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AGI 还需十年以上，仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective functions; no single model will rule, and companies should train their own.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他指出前沿实验室因目标函数不同而分化，不会有一个模型统治一切，每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: Human judgment becomes more critical as AI hallucinates; safety must prioritize over accuracy in medicine.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的思考深化：随着 AI 幻觉，人类判断更关键；在医学中安全必须优先于准确性。

edwinchen.en: AI in medicine risks omission—failing to act—and can homogenize writing, but also frees deeper thinking.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出医学中 AI 的最大风险是遗漏——未能采取行动，并可能同质化写作，但也释放深度思考。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to achieve broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响；AlphaFold 3、GraphCast、GNOME、FunSearch、AlphaGeometry 都是这一思路的体现。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他提出大语言模型的幻觉若与真值检测器配对，可被用于创造性发现，而非只被视为缺陷。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, by using hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他坚持用困难评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化而非记忆，这一主线贯穿其科学 AI 工作。

kohli.en: DeepMind avoids problems solvable by top universities, focusing on those requiring scale.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他表示 DeepMind 避开顶尖大学能解决的问题，专注需要 Scaling（规模扩张）才能攻克的问题。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：后训练结合强化学习，是推动 AI 超越人类知识的关键，AlphaGo 的搜索与 AlphaZero 的自学已延伸到科学问题。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI, grounding knowledge and reducing hallucinations; LLMs are OS-like with tools and vector DBs.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径，能 grounding 知识、减少幻觉；LLM 像操作系统，语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning should only be a cherry on top; unsupervised learning does most work, with RL for low-level control and LLMs for high-level planning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习承担主要工作；强化学习适合低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划。

jimfan.en: Simulation enables massive parallelization and safe exploration for embodied agents; internet pre-training tokens are running out, but embodied worlds provide infinite data.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他指出模拟能为具身智能体提供大规模并行化和安全探索；互联网预训练 token 将耗尽，但具身世界提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: Data is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：数据是机器人学的主要瓶颈；通过模拟和世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away, home use longer.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张：简单、端到端、能利用多样数据的机器人基础模型是关键；机器人学的 GPT-3 时刻约五年后到来，家用因安全和非结构化环境更晚。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；把一切输入 token 化的通才智能体是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn as humans do.
nando.zh: 像 YouTube 这样的视频学习能让智能体无需昂贵的强化学习即可训练；机器人应像人类一样学习。

nando.en: Large models excite but are not everything; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, and diversity is essential.
nando.zh: 大模型令人兴奋但并非全部；根本性创新可以来自任何地方，多样性与包容对 AI 社区至关重要。

nando.en: The goal remains AI that augments scientists and laborers, creating new symbols and knowledge.
nando.zh: 目标始终是让 AI 增强科学家与劳动者，创造新的符号与知识——这一主线从 2023 延续到 2026。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are now the biggest challenges; solutions remain open, not solved.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，AI 安全与负责任部署成为最大挑战；这仍是开放问题，尚无解决方案。

nando.en: Africa is not behind in AI; it leapfrogs legacy gaps, with local-language models revolutionizing education.
nando.zh: 非洲在 AI 上并不落后；它跨越了历史遗留差距，本地语言模型正在革新教育。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental—a hackathon demo, not a polished product; the $20 price came from a Google Form survey, not strategy.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他坦言 ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的——它只是黑客松项目，本意是研究演示而非成品；20 美元定价来自谷歌表单调查，并非战略定价。

turley.en: The model is the product; iterate on it like software, ship daily, and use real-world feedback to discover emergent properties.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他提出“模型即产品”，要像软件一样迭代模型、每日发布，用真实世界反馈来发现涌现能力。

turley.en: Chat is not the future—it's like MS-DOS; AI should render its own UI and integrate into existing tools, evolving beyond turn-by-turn chat.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他判断聊天不是未来——它像 MS-DOS；AI 应渲染自己的界面并融入现有工具，交互将超越逐轮对话。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他强调安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: The vision is a personalized AI assistant that knows your goals, has context, and takes actions—amplifying human capability, not replacing humans.
turley.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的愿景一以贯之：打造个性化 AI 助手，了解你的目标、拥有上下文并能采取行动，放大而非取代人类能力。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention; growth came one-third from friction removal, one-third core product, one-third model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他明确 ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存；增长三分之一来自消除摩擦，三分之一来自核心产品投入，三分之一来自模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他指出下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的、主动且可供性丰富的产品；推理模型在被无缝产品化时具有变革性。

turley.en: Pricing will evolve as technology changes; unlimited plans may become unsustainable, and subscriptions were introduced to shape demand gracefully.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他预判定价将随技术演变，无限套餐可能不可持续；订阅制的推出是为了优雅地塑造需求，而非盈利。

turley.en: Distribution alone (Meta, Google) was not enough to win the AI race; power users are crucial for product discovery, not just revenue.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他反思仅靠分发（如 Meta、Google）不足以赢得 AI 竞赛；重度用户对产品发现至关重要，而不仅是收入来源。

turley.en: Curiosity is the most important skill in the AI era—asking good questions—and writing remains valuable because it forces clear thinking.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他认为好奇心是 AI 时代最重要的技能——提出好问题；写作仍有价值，因为它迫使清晰思考。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner, and design and engineering are merging.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈；AI 是创作伙伴，设计与工程正在融合。

nadchishtie.en: Quality fluctuates like debt and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt, through rapid scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量像债务一样波动，需与技债一起迭代偿还，靠快速粗糙的实验推进。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams beat large squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行、用 AI 补位的通才最有价值；小团队优于 8-10 人的跨职能小队。

nadchishtie.en: Hiring favors high-slope, intrinsically driven learners; side projects and paid test work outweigh traditional experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 招聘看重高斜率、内在驱动的学习者；副业项目与付费测试胜过传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成常态；不采用它就像早期无视互联网。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped: it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence; fine-tuning may become obsolete as adaptive compute enables dynamic specialization.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他强调长上下文被低估：它解决「上手」问题并大幅提升智能；随着自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with reliability—not capability—the bar for agents.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他转向以可验证奖励的强化学习为核心突破：预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI，智能体的门槛是可靠性而非能力。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; coding is the leading indicator, and long agentic coherence plus inference compute will bottleneck progress by 2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他把强化学习视为新的 Scaling 轴：编程是领先指标，长时程智能体连贯性与推理算力将在 2028 年前成为瓶颈。

sholto.en: Transformers suffice for AGI; progress is exponential, not plateauing, and current training pipelines remain primitive with huge room to improve.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持 Transformer 足以实现 AGI：进展是指数级的而非停滞，当前训练流程仍很原始、改进空间巨大。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration beats raw intelligence; compute is the new oil, world models are off the critical path, and agents are managed as fleets.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他认为能力过剩使编排比原始智能更重要：算力是新石油，世界模型不在关键路径上，未来是管理智能体集群。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning, using familiar interaction patterns.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当写代码以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本，不要在交互设计上创新，而要用熟悉模式换速度。

henrymodisett.en: Design systems are semantic and code reuse is essential, not Figma libraries; not every surface needs perfection—chase ROI.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他提出设计系统是语义性的，代码复用才是关键，而非 Figma 组件库；并非每个界面都要做到完美，应按 ROI 决定把什么做精。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should prioritize recruiting and differentiation; AI hardware will compete on design like radios, commoditizing tech.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他认为初创公司的品牌战略应优先服务招聘与差异化；AI 硬件会像收音机一样在设计上竞争，从而让技术本身商品化。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, giving designers ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计提升为战略武器：创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，并给设计师所有权与自主权，让他们做决策、成长。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool, so invest early and hire diverse archetypes, not clones.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步说人们加入的是品牌而非公司，品牌叙事是招聘工具；因此要尽早投资品牌，并招聘多元类型的人才而非克隆人。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness beat perfection; avoid structured design crits, adapt process to the problem, and in fast-growing startups gut decisions often beat data.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他仍坚持速度与决断胜过完美：避免结构化设计评审，让流程适配问题；在高速成长的初创公司里，直觉决策常常胜过数据驱动。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict AI progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测 AI 进步，但已提出推理时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体虽有前景但还不够实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，这一判断延续到 2025 年。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, speed and cost; every magic moment in Cursor involves one.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他从使用前沿模型转向强调自研定制模型的必要性，认为 Cursor 每个神奇时刻都离不开定制模型。

truell.en: Programming moves from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 2025 年他深化为编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，但人类始终在驾驶座上。

truell.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 变革定位为比互联网更深远、需数十年展开，并认为品味与逻辑设计能力将比谨慎更值钱。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; pre-training's next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning, so better algorithms and data can let smaller models outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她质疑单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题，认为预训练的下一个词预测目标与人类学习根本错位；更好的算法与数据能让小模型在特定任务上超越大模型。

yejin.en: RLHF is crucial for safe, pleasant responses, yet its data is proprietary and brute-force; open alternatives and moral-norm teaching are needed despite value pluralism.
yejin.zh: 同年她强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全、友好的回应至关重要，但批评其数据封闭且粗暴，主张开放替代方案，并指出教模型道德规范因价值多元而成为棘手的计算问题。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge rather than transcending it, and RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
yejin.zh: 到 2025 年，她把数据视为根本瓶颈，认为当前 AI 只是插值人类知识而非超越；并指出 RLVR 可能在 best-of-n 提升的同时反而降低 pass@k。

yejin.en: Abductive reasoning and falsification are key to scientific discovery; AI must explore unknown knowledge beyond the internet, with open research and cross-institution collaboration.
yejin.zh: 同年她主张溯因推理与证伪是科学发现的关键，AI 必须探索互联网之外的未知知识，并强调开放研究与跨机构合作以抗衡封闭的前沿实验室。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can rival frontier models; RL as a pre-training objective yields lasting reasoning gains despite high compute.
yejin.zh: 2026 年她进一步论证：用多样化合成数据与多元对齐武装的小语言模型可媲美前沿模型；把强化学习作为预训练目标虽算力昂贵，却能带来持久的推理提升。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, though internals remain opaque alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 大语言模型通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完备问题；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术般不透明。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app; unforeseen applications emerge, and models should learn by acting in the world, not just passively observing data.
shazeer.zh: 对话是杀手级应用；最佳应用常出乎创造者预料，模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非仅被动观察数据。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are major near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力扩展与更长的上下文窗口是近期重大机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Reinforcement learning and agentic capabilities in complex environments are crucial for AGI; test-time compute alone won't get there.
shazeer.zh: 强化学习与复杂环境中的智能体式能力对 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要；仅靠推理时算力无法实现 AGI。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will far exceed trillion-dollar products, with coding enabling self-acceleration of AI progress.
shazeer.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）被低估；其经济影响将远超万亿美元级产品，而编程作为应用被低估，它推动 AI 进展自我加速。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap. Build skills, don't fear capability research. Alignment and robustness need empirical work.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口；建议先积累技能而非回避能力研究，对齐与鲁棒性亟需实证研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs. Need scalable oversight, interpretability, automated alignment. Evaluation easier than generation; alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人类输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐；评估比生成容易，对齐可能比想象中简单。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment dissolved, compute promises broken. Post-training alone insufficient for AGI. Third-party testing and regulation needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，超级对齐团队解散、算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练无法解决 AGI 对齐，需要第三方测试与监管。

leike.en: Alignment is empirically testable and progress measurable now. Interpretability is key to detect deception. Uncertainty about true alignment is the biggest risk.
leike.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：对齐可实证检验、进展可衡量；可解释性是检测欺骗的关键；对系统是否真正对齐的不确定性才是最大风险。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; self-play and imitation learning provide strong learning signals.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，而自对弈和模仿学习能提供强学习信号。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他转向无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率，并主张先验知识应用于数据生成或增强，而非硬编码进网络。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained models and fine-tuning transfer across domains, from language reasoning to robotics tasks.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他持续关注预训练模型与微调的跨域迁移能力，从语言推理模式迁移到机器人任务。

abbeel.en: A single neural network can generalize across warehouse tasks and end effectors, achieving 99.9% reliability for real value.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他提出单一神经网络可泛化到不同仓库任务和末端执行器，并强调 99.9%可靠性才能创造真实价值。

abbeel.en: Curiosity-driven exploration fails in open-ended real-world environments; simulation ensembles may transfer better than a single precise simulator.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿 2018 至 2021 年，他认为好奇心驱动的探索在开放式真实环境中会失败，而模拟器集成可能比单一精确模拟器更利于现实迁移。
